notes.title: UPDATE 2.30 - Major Rotation Speed Increase + Better Thrust Controls!

This is a very small update but massive in terms of the better controls you should feel when playing the main mission mode of Rock 'N Roll.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YfhaDkGaUz0&t=8s

Rotation Speed has been increased to almost double the previous speed, so right from the start you'll likely notice a lot faster rotation speed of your ship. Enjoy and remember that Rock 'N Roll is great music.. and of course a great retro action arcade game as well!   ;-)

notes.title: UPDATE 2.25 - Azsloth Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29389580/ab2e84332d34cc8f11c80412dca182b246d07a35.png[/img]

Update 2.25 has arrived, and Rock 'N Roll finally has a threat to motivate players to keep moving like I originally intended for Rock 'N Roll at launch more than two years ago!  

Just as the G.E.O.S. gems are your only chance to save the Earth from the impending doom and made up of life magic, Azsloth is made possible from a dark magic traveling from the Earth back to where you are in space.  Hope has already been lost back on Earth by the majority of the population where crime, murder and chaos has run rampant.  Most back home do not trust you to be able to save them, and their fears and lack of trust formed in the despair of their hearts helps form the deadliest threat you've ever faced in Rock 'N Roll!

Azsloth represents the anger of the desperate and fearful billions of lives back on Earth who's spirits get angry when you don't stay motivated towards saving them.  To them, positioning yourself in one spot and firing away represents laziness and no interest in saving them from the threat of the millions of asteroids.

Facing Azsloth will not be in your best interest if you are indeed wanting to save the Earth because his presence will likely mean the loss of your invaluable lives.  To prevent him from being born from the asteroids, you'll need to keep your ship moving and keep the green cheetah and border green in color.  The new UI now shows your current speed and your average speed.  It is your average speed that is used to turn the cheetah to the green color which means you are safe from Azsloth being born.

The game continually checks your average speed versus the current number of asteroids on the screen.  The more asteroids and danger that are present, the lower your average speed requirement is to prevent the spawning of Azsloth. 

The game will give you three "Get Moving" warning with the dark magic energy all over your screen before Azsloth will form from any remaining asteroids on your screen.  The more asteroids he consumes, the more health he will have!  He has a variety of different attacks, so be ready for anything!

Even if you defeat Azsloth, you haven't actually won the battle yet as his death will leave behind lots of asteroids and also chunks of his body that will spell death to you if you collide with any of them!  His body parts can be destroyed with the same attack that Azsloth is most vulnerable to when he is alive, so keep that in mind.

Also note that Azsloth is only in the Mission mode of the game and nothing has changed with the Hard Rock mode.

Good luck and have fun playing this new challenging version of Rock 'N Roll that should keep you on your toes and make your gameplay more exciting than ever before!

notes.title: UPDATE 2.21 - For the Love of Rock 'N Roll, Asteroid Shooting Gets Less Tedius & More Fun!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I sat down and played Rock 'N Roll last night for the first time in a long time and it's amazing how much you learn as you developer other games.  I've changed a few things and fixed a few annoying little problems with this update..

- The collision box of your bullets has been doubled to make hitting the small asteroids and asteroid chunks (when asteroids crumble) much easier and less tedious to hit.  I had increased the collision box of the smallest chunks not long after Rock 'N Roll launched back in the summer of 2017, but now adding a bigger hitbox for your bullets just makes blasting the rocks much more enjoyable!

- Increased the fire range of your standard bullets by 25%.  Decreased the range of Rapid Fire bullets by 18%.  Rapid Fire Bullets now have only a slightly longer ranger than your normal fire but still have a much faster rate of fire.

- Changed the color of your bullets to a light red when you have the Rapid Fire power-up and to a light blue color when you have the Bouncy Shots power-up to help distinguish the bullets and what power-up you have at all times.

- Adjusted all asteroids wrap-around ranges so they will no longer "pop" in on top of you when wrapping from side to side of from top to bottom.  All asteroids should now smoothly move when wrapping around making the edges of the screen all the way around much more predictable and less risky to a big asteroid just wrapping around and landing right on top of you.

- Adjusted the score for defeating the Monster Rock boss mode VDS from 15,000 points to 50,000 points as defeating him after the long battle just needed bigger rewards in contrast to the other two boss modes.

- Fixed an issue that prevent you from being able to use a MESA shield protection power-up you collect on the next level if you already had MESA when you collected the power-up.

- Fixed an issue that would prevent you from getting shot accuracy bonus points after defeating a wave of asteroids on the statistics screen between levels.  You would get the bonus points prior but only if you wanted about 5 seconds before moving to the Galactic Selling Station, this will now make sure you get your shot accuracy bonus points no matter how quickly you move to the Galactic Selling Station.

- Fixed the scoring stats area at the end game screen so that there is now room to show how many asteroids you destroyed in total without these numbers showing up over the description text if the numbers were more than 3 digits (1,000+)

- Fixed an issue that would cause a full screen game to go back to a windowed mode every time you go back to the main menu screen from any other screen.

- Adjusted the color of your trail to a pinkish purple when playing the Hard Rock Mode.

- Added shot smoke effects to help show where the asteroids were shot at you from on the borders in the Hard Rock mode.

- Changed the look of your thrust effects as well as your movement trail in the Mission mode to have a cleaner look.

- Changed the look of your ship to have a cleaner, less blurred look in the Mission mode.

notes.title: UPDATE 2.15 - More Fixes Come, Mostly To the Monster Rock Boss Mode..

- Fixed an issue that caused an upgraded a55 turret to get stuck in the electrical monster rock shrinking beam

- Fixed an issue that would cause using dynamite on the monster rock to change a realistic monster rock to a hand drawn rock

- Fixed an issue that would cause the monster rock to not take correct damage from a dynamite blast.  This now works as intended.

- Nerfed the A55 turret when shooting the VDS as the A55 was simply way too powerful against the VDS.  The upgraded a55 will now properly hunt down the VDS but it will take it about four times as long to do similar damage to the VDS as before.

- In the Galactic Upgrade Center, the GEOS sign will now properly turn off after you've purchased your limit of one per visit to the station.

- Decreased the time between Earth explosions in the end game fate screen to reduce the waiting time as the 50 earths explode after you've protected you choice of Earth reflections with any GEOS gems you earned

notes.title: UPDATE 2.14 - All Cheats Explained To Help Newer Players AND Fixes To Some Minor Issues in the Monster Rock Mode!
notes.notes:
In this update, I've fixed a couple of issues that would only occur while in the Monster Rock mode seen here:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/8fc31ba0d4af38184947317fa0e7648f850ad4cc.png[/img]

In the Monster Rock Mode, your ship will be blue if healthy and red in color if you are damaged as in the asteroid blasting normal mode.  

Also, because of the ability to pick up health to heal the Earth with in this mode, if you are blue (healthy) when you pick up a health delivery, you will turn purple in color to show that you are both healthy and have a health delivery you can take to Earth to help deal some of its damage.

If you pick up a health delivery for Earth while injured or if you are purple in color which is healthy and take damage from a smaller rock, you will turn pink in color to reflect that you are both damaged and have a health deliver for Earth.

Prior to this update, you would be invincible to taking damage from rocks while injured with a health delivery for Earth.  This has been fixed and you will now explode and lose a life if you crash while injured with a health delivery for Earth.

Also, before this update, sometimes you would never heal from damage if you were pink in color (damaged and carrying a health delivery for Earth).  This has been corrected in this update.

Also before this update, sometimes after delivering health to the Earth, your ship would stay purple and not change back to the correct color causing a little confusion while playing.  This situation has been fixed in this update.

Please note that all fixes and this update were made to ONLY THE MONSTER ROCK boss battle.

---------------------

Please remember a few things with Rock 'N Roll:

When playing the Mission Mode, you can save a game in progress while visiting the Upgrade Space Station between levels of asteroids.  To save a game while visiting the Upgrade Station, simply press the F1, F2, F3 or F4 key.  There are four grey ball indicators seen at the update station reflecting any current game saves that exist (an existing game save will be green).

To load an existing saved game, just press the desired F1, F2, F3, or F4 key while at the game's main menu.  (Again, existing saved games will be shown on the main menu with green lit up spheres in the bottom right of the main menu screen)

Also from the Main Menu, you can activate a few cheats:

- Press CTRL and the G key to start the Mission Mode with 500,000 in GalaxCasH.

- Press CTRL and the M key to start the Mission Mode at the Monster Rock boss screen allowing you to play this boss battle right from the start!

- Press CTRL and the P key to start the Mission Mode at the Earth Protect! bonus level allowing you to play this bonus level to rack up some easy points and GalaxCasH!

Also another cheat is available while playing any boss battle or any asteroid level of the Mission mode and this will add 5 extra lives for you with a single press of the F5 key on your keyboard!  You can use this cheat as many times as you desire, the only limit is that you can never have more than 99 using this F5 single key cheat!

* Please note that using any of the above four cheats described will label you as a cheater at the end game statistic screen when your game is over AND using any of these cheats will also prevent your high score from being uploaded to the Steam high score list for that game the cheat was used.

..No harm will come from using these cheats, so have fun with them and use them if you desire to play the game how you want to play it!

I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: UPDATE 2.12 - Introducing the All New "Earth Protect!" Bonus Round! How Many Points Can You Rack Up?
notes.notes:
Last weekend, I launched "Monster Rock" to Rock 'N Roll to give players another challenging yet fun end level battle in this game...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/ff433e47bcd9966f25f5417c7db77b0507ec22f8.png[/img]

And now, I am pleased to say a whole new end-level bonus round has been coded and added to Rock 'N Roll!  I call this new mode "Earth Protect!" and while it's all about blasting asteroids again, this time things work a little different.

Once you start the Earth Protect mode, you'll quickly see that you can no longer fly around wherever you desire, but instead rotate around the Earth in an orbit.  Simply rotate clockwise or counter clockwise and blast the incoming asteroids before they smack the Earth!  You'll see how many asteroids at it's usual location in the UI and the trick here is simply keeping Earth as healthy as you can before the round ends.  

- The Earth CANNOT be destroyed on this mode!

- You CANNOT die in this mode!

"Earth Protect" is all about giving you a fun round to try and gobble up some resources to sell and score as many points as you can before it ends.  In the middle of the UI, right underneath the Earths health bar, you'll see the score for this round so far, and to the right of that you'll see a score multiplier.  Keep Earth from getting a scratch, and after the last asteroid has been taken out, you could rake up to a 50X score multiplier!  ..That's the potential for a lot of points just for having a quick fun round with zero risk of losing lives or getting the Earth destroyed!


CONTROLS for Earth Protect:

With the controller, left and right on your left thumb stick rotate your ship around Earths orbit.  A button to fire, and right throttle allows you to move at double speed around the the Earth.

Using the Keyboard and Mouse:

A & D to rotate left and right.  W or SHIFT moves you at double speed around the Earth.  Left Mouse button or Space fires.

The R key on the keyboard can be toggled on and off in this round to give you permanent 2X speed without needing to use a button or key to throttle.  Each game will remember this throttle setting if you play more then one round of Earth Protect in a game, but if you start a new game, you'll need to hit the R key again to activate it again.

Keep in mind, all of the key bindings are adjustable to whatever keys you prefer from the controls settings on the main menu.

Health packs can be collected in this round as they pass by and instantly restore a little of the damage done to the Earth.  Resources will also float by you to tempt you.  Resources score their typical immediate points for collecting them and can be sold at the Galactic Selling Station after the bonus round for the usual choices of either more points or GalaxCasH to buy cool stuff and upgrades at the Galactic Upgrade Station (GUS).

This table, though old now is still very accurate today on points and GalaxCasH values I do believe.  It should give you a good idea anyhow of what is worth what if you haven't seen this chart yet:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/6c2fca98277a779f1ba8c630a7940353db13e3d1.jpg[/img]

Want to play or try out the "Earth Protect!" mode without needing to advance there?  As with my "Monster Rock!" end-level challenge mode I added last week, you can start a new game right at the "Earth Protect!" mode by holding CTRL and pressing the P key on your keyboard from the Main Menu.  As with using CTRL and M to go right to "Monster Rock!" from the main menu, this will label you as a "cheater" at the end game stat screen and your game score will NOT be uploaded to Steam.  But this offers you a fast and easy way to jump right to the content you want should you feel the desire to do so!  ..Options are always good, right?  ;-)

I hope you all have a great weekend and Happy Fathers Day to you all especially if you are a father out there!

As always, "Rock On!"

notes.title: UPDATE 2.11 - Another Step in Overhauling Rock 'N Rolls Overall Look & Feel! - Completely New Upgrade Station Mechanics!
notes.notes:
In update 2.10, along with the Monster Rock content, an new selling screen was introduced to Rock 'N Roll to give it a clean and fresh look.

In this update, I've completely overhauled the Galactic Upgrade Station, and even gave it a brand new nickname I call "GUS"!  We all love visiting good ol' GUS don't we?  ;-)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/77767df141614a0821ac405bbb45373f06210f83.png[/img]

Now, instead of just moving a highlighter around the screen to choose your upgrades, you can actually fly your ship around and highlight exactly what you're interested in!  When your ship is over a desired choice, you'll see both your cash and the cost of the upgrade item in the familiar new UI at the top of the screen.  Simply fire with the controller or the mouse to make your purchase!

Spherical indicators also show you any game saves you currently have, so you'll always know if you have any empty save slots available to save your game on this screen as well.  Remember that game loads are done from the main menu, and the you can only save your game progress from the Galactic Upgrade Station ("GUS").  The game save indicators here now are consistent with the game load indicators seen on the new start menu introduced back in April.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/e54eef879edd716e3018aad2ed0174fb9bd341a7.png[/img]

*** The Spawn Rates of ALL AI Enemies has been Increased ***

Not only have I increased the rate of enemy spawn during your normal waves of levels closer to what it used to be last summer when Rock 'N Roll was brand new, but I've also given the RSA (the red shooter alien that looks like red space jellyfish) a big hunger for resources!  The RSA absolutely loves, loves, loves him some delicious cobalt, but any resource will do if he sees it now!  The shinier it is, the better it tastes in his eyes!  

The RSA will now target and eat any resource within his vision as he continues to fire away at anything within range!  Once you or your A55 destroy him, you'll have a chance to recover up to two or three resources he has gobbled up.  Remember that the RSA will vanish if he goes off the left or right side of the screen, so be sure you blast him if you catch him devouring one of those valuable resources!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/0b20cee1ed6e5f81a04a08d974effdf3ff8b4452.png[/img]

There's still more work to be done, but I feel that Rock 'N Roll is slowly getting sleeker and looking a little better with each new update.  ..Please let me know what you think in the comments below and as always.. "Rock On Baby!"

notes.notes:
It's here people.. and it's live NOW!

This is the 100th update and announcement for Rock 'N Roll since it was first uploaded onto the Steam platform a year ago this month!  This makes the 68th actual game update announcement, while the other 32 have been announcements about other topics regarding this game.

I'm proud to announce that "Monster Rock" is the biggest update to the game to date offering a whole new twist to protecting the Earth!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/8fc31ba0d4af38184947317fa0e7648f850ad4cc.png[/img]

Rock 'N Roll was always about protecting your loved ones back home on Earth, and those valuable G.E.O.S. gems (Galactic Emeralds of Sacrifice) are about to be more important than ever before!  

In this all new boss battle mode, you'll be trying to protect Earth from getting destroyed and see it right on your screen!  The evil and vile VDS is back and angrier than ever as he starts the action off by spawning in a massive asteroid (thus the name "Monster Rock").  You cannot simply kill the VDS in the first part of this epic battle as an electrical barrier keeps you and the VDS on separate sides of the screen, but that's okay because your priority now is keeping the Earth safe from harm!

Shots fired at the Monster Rock from both you and the VDS will slowly move this massive granite danger from and towards the Earth.  If the Monster Rock crashes into the Earth, it's all over... unless you happen to have purchased or earned a G.E.O.S. gem before this war takes place!  The G.E.O.S. gems will automatically be used to save the Earth just before it shatters into a cloud of blue and brown dust as long as you have any to spare!  Whew!  ..Thank goodness for those precious little magical gems, eh?

The VDS mission is to destroy the Earth, and if he does, it's an immediate "Game Over" for you in this boss battle!  You won't go on if the Earth is destroyed here, even if you own 27 ships!  ..No pressure!

Your mission is to protect the Earth and destroy this massive asteroid before it's too late!  To destroy it, you'll need to use your firepower to push it into the electrical barrier than separates you from the dreaded VDS (Vaporous Death Spewer).  Over time under the electrical charges of this barrier, the massive Monster Rock will slowly break down in size.  Be careful however, as every time the massive rock breaks down, several asteroids are likely to fall off and present risk to both you and the Earth that you are trying to protect!

If you succeed in destroying the Monster Rock, don't breathe a deep breath yet, as your battle has only begun!  Now, the electrical barrier will shut down and it will be your chance to get your revenge on the VDS who caused this whole mess!  Taking him out as he roams freely about blasting rocks, you, and the Earth is probably easier said than done!

An A55 Kicker cannot be carried into this end level boss battle, however you can craft an A55 at a reduced cost by collecting the needed resource (shown to you in the same UI location as usual)

This boss battle has none of the usual power-ups from the normal levels found in Rock 'N Roll, however there is one power-up that you'll likely see in this new war!  A red cross might be seen spawning at random locations occasionally, and if you collect it, your ship will change colors letting you know you've picked it up.  Simply move your ship over the Earth to deliver instant healing power to your home planet!

If you succeed in this all new mission, you'll be rewarded huge with both points and loot, but that hardly compares to the satisfaction of knowing you've protected all of your loved ones back home on Earth, right?

*********
Want to try out "Monster Rock" but don't want to bother having to advance through one or two levels of asteroids to play it?

...No problem!

From the main menu, just hold down CTRL and hit your M key and you'll activate the "Monster Rock" cheat which will take you right to the battle with 5 handy dandy G.E.O.S. gems to use if needed as well!

NOTES:  The Monster Rock cheat will flag you as a "cheater" on the final statistics screen at the end of your game (just for fun) and the Monster Rock content is not available in the Rock 'N Roll demo.  - You'll need to purchase Rock 'N Roll to play this all new content, sorry!  ;-)

*********

^^^^^^^_  OTHER CHANGES MADE IN UPDATE 2.10  _^^^^^^^

* The look of the Galactic Resource Selling Station has been changed for a new, fresh look and feel.

* You'll now have the opportunity to sell your resources after the asteroid wave before you enter the boss battle (which could now be either the alien boss ship or the monster rock content) and again you'll go to the Galactic Selling Station after your boss battle before then moving on the the Galactic Upgrade Station.  So, you'll now be able to sell your resources twice, once before the boss battle, and once after the boss battle.. before moving to the upgrade station.

* Fixed an issue which caused the mystery power-up to sometimes not be any power-up at all.

* Fixed an issue with the 25 GEOS Gems Steam achievement not sending the information to Steam.  If you've earned this achievement in the past, it should now show as a completed Steam achievement.

------------------------

I'm sure there will be some issues and bugs that come up as people play my new content in Rock 'N Roll.  Please feel free to tell me your thoughts below and also please use the sticky bug reporting thread in the forums should you find any bugs or issues that might occur.

Monster Rock is something I first came up with as just an idea way back in January of this year, and I'm happy to say that it is finally here!

As always, "Rock On!"  I hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: UPDATE 2.07 - Extra Life Save/Load Exploit Bug Fixed, New Boss Sound Effects, More!
notes.notes:
Today while playing my own game, I came across a big time glitch I simply overlooked when I added the save and load game feature to this game back in January when it was requested by a player in the forums.

While the save game feature saved 44 different variables to keep track of all your stats, GEOS gems, lives, score, prices, stats, and everything in the upgrade station.. I overlooked saving one vital thing (variable in code terms).  I forgot to save the games tracking of how many extra lives it had already given you as a player!  OMG, how could I have overlooked that!?!  haha!

So basically what could happen is that a player could have a good game going, get to 500k points for example and make it to the Upgrade station, save the game, then quit and reload the game and the game would give the player the 11 extra lives they had already earned before saving the game AGAIN!  If the score was a million when they saved the game and then reloaded that saved game, the game would give them 21 additional lives!  

Embarrassing mistake, especially since I didn't find it in my own testing of the game since I added in the save & load feature back in January!  None-the-less, it has been fixed now, and looking at the high scores, it doesn't really look like anyone else found it or abused it, perhaps maybe the top high score now perhaps took advantage of that, hard to say for sure, - but the 1.8 million high score is certainly achievable without taking advantage of this little bug exploit.  I see no reason to reset the current high score list.

Also added to the game in this patch:

* New Boss Sound effect:  Whenever the end level boss changes it's vulnerable side to a new side of his ship, you'll hear a new sound.  Watch the "BOSS HP" word before the boss health bar to see what side of the boss is most vulnerable to your attack when you hear this sound! (the vulnerable side of the end level boss ship is shown by a bar either on the top side, bottom side, left side, or right side of the words "BOSS HP:"

* If you get an A55 Kicker power up and then earn another A55 on the same level so you have two A55 Kickers when the level is cleared, you'll now get to take BOTH A55 Kickers in against the end level boss with you!

* The end level boss is now about 50% less likely to now shoot at your A55 Kicker(s) when it fires a lightning ball shot, which means those shots are now likely headed right at YOU instead!  This change was made to try and help players keep their A55's a little longer in these end level boss battles.  Also remember that the end level boss always makes a low "chug" sound just before it fires a shot to give you time to dodge out of harm's way.  Make sure your effects volume is turned up in the game settings if you can't hear it!

* Fixed a visual bug that caused your saved game indicators from the main menu to sometimes look weird when going back to the main menu from the Controls menu.

Besides that, it's the same game!  Keep Rocking and please let me know if you come across any bugs or glitches or if you have any other feedback or suggestions.. that is what the forums are for!  

:-)

notes.title: UPDATE 2.06 - Small Fix & E.T. Doesn't Heal You Anymore
notes.notes:
Really small update here people, but I finally tracked down and squashed a little bug that happened on rare occasion since I added the E.T. power-up.  

What would sometimes happen is if you collected an Smasher power-up (which should turn your ship green in color or yellow in color if you are damaged at the time) it would instead give your ship the E.T. cloaked look.  You wouldn't really have E.T. and would really have the Smasher power-up but when this happened it would or could definitely be confusing.

That bug was finally squashed I do believe, and as always, a developer always hopes that fixing one bug doesn't create another issue somewhere else, lol

I also changed the E.T. power-up so that if you collect this power-up while damaged (red in color), you'll now see your ship cloaked but see a red outline around the edge of your ship indicating that after your E.T. power-up expires, you'll go back to the damaged state and need to wait the remaining time for your ship to self repair.  

For example, if you take a hit from an asteroid that doesn't kill you but changes your ship to red and the auto-repair time is 20 seconds... if you collect an E.T. power-up exactly 8 seconds after taking that hit, you'll see the E.T. power-up with a red outline which doesn't change the power-up itself.  You'll still be invulnerable until the power-up time expires, but when the power-up time does expire, your ship will go back red in color showing you are still damaged and in auto-repair for the remaining 12 seconds.

Hopefully that makes sense.  It's pretty simple to understand just playing the game and seeing it all happen live.

Anyhow, that's it for this update.  I'm still trying to figure out how to implement the Monster Rocks into the game in a way that I really like.  I've tried and tested a couple of different things, but i'm just not happy with it yet.  I don't want to just add something to my game that doesn't feel right or that isn't as much fun as it should be.  I'm sure I'll figure it out in time however.

If you have any ideas, notice any imbalances, bugs, or issues.. or if you have any suggestions, as always please feel free to comment below or in the forums for this game!

As always, Rock On!

notes.title: UPDATE 2.05 - A Few Changes & "Easy 99 Lives" Cheat Is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  I hope you all are doing well out there!  This update should make any of you that find this game just a little difficult but "fun" happy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/8665716fe3f063f188b3a99b40d1f4889aa4d95c.png[/img]

Now at any time during your normal game mode you can simply press the F5 key to immediately be awarded an extra 5 lives!  You can also spam the F5 key to quickly give yourself up to 99 lives at any given time!  That's right!  (You need to make sure your ship is spawned to use this cheat as in make sure you're not dead waiting to re-spawn)  Using this cheat even once during your game will void your high score being uploaded to the Steam high score leaderboards however.  ..I know, I'm no fun, lol.

Other changes in this update:

- The A55 Kicker has been added to the tutorial mode to assist you in cleaning up the asteroids quickly.

- The Level Selection screen has been completely changed to now just give a brief objective and show you the power-ups you can collect in game versus the walls of text seen before.

- You can no longer save your game immediately after loading a saved game.  You'll need to advance at least one level and visit the Galactic Upgrade Center again before it will allow you to save your game.  (You'll get a voice message telling you this if you try to save your game right after loading)

- The slow music from the end game now stops as it should if you choose to play a new game. (bug fix)

- Your money is now properly saved and loaded when you save your game (bug fix)

- The end boss ship looks have been edited to give it a better overall appearance and shocking look

- You should no longer be able to collect "Close Call" bonus points while shielded for the 5 seconds after spawning a new ship.

- If you collect all the resources and power-ups after killing a boss, the game will move you immediately to the "Level Complete" screen without making you wait for the remaining count down.

- The main menu now shows the two cheats available in the game.  Cheat Greedy which can give you an extra $500,000 game cash and can be used once per game from the main menu and the new +5 lives cheat from the main game at any time.  Keep in mind that the +5 cheat will prevent any high score you achieve from being uploaded to the Steam leaderboards, however using Cheat Greedy for $500,000 cash will still upload a high score if you set one.  Both cheats will stamp your final stats screen as a "CHEATER!" however.

That's about it for this update, please let me know if you experience any new bugs or issues with this update and as always, comments and your thoughts are always appreciated!

Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE 2.03 - Doing Great In Rock 'N Roll And Something Comes Up? Save Your Game and Load It All Back Later! + Intense 1,000 Point Close Calls Return!
notes.notes:
I've been really busy the past couple of weeks updating Rock 'N Roll with a lot of new stuff, most of it coming from the single negative review I've received and suggestions from fans of this game!  

In this patch, the big addition is the ability to save your game progress during the middle of a standard game and reload it back up at your convenience!  This was a suggestion made by Steam user Arkabed, and I am thankful to everyone for their feedback and suggestions!

You have four possible game save slots available at any given time now, and the game shows you exactly where they are and what key press is used to activate them when you are ready!  Game saves are tied to the F1, F2, F3, and F4 function keys.

TO LOAD A PREVIOUSLY SAVED GAME:

notes.title: UPDATE 2.01 - The Extreme "UP YOUR A55" Update is Live! - You can now upgrade that A55 Kicker!
notes.notes:
In this update, which I've called the "Up Your A55" update, you can now give your little aluminum beer can & duct tape space turret the ability to move on it's own towards asteroids and enemies in its range!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/0c39ed8146ed4efe1583cdb9792c9c8bc070f65d.png[/img]

The A55 Kicker was born in Rock 'N Roll way back in early October.  Almost four months later, this little bad boy friendly turret finally gets an optional upgrade!  He is very happy as he's been pretty envious of all your possible upgrades since he was born!  

The A55 Kicker has to be crafted before you'll get an option to upgrade it.  

The A55 Power-up collected A55 Kicker will also be upgraded if you craft another A55 Kicker and choose the upgrade.  The cost is the same regardless.

The cost of choosing the A55 Kicker Upgrade is HALF of all resources you collect on that level (both before and after the A55 Kicker was crafted)  This means that if you collect 5 Rhodiums and 7 Platinums on a given level, the cost will always be the higher of the split, so the cost would be 3 Rhodium and 4 Platinum and the same for every other resource type collected.

The A55 Kicker Upgrade takes approx 30 - 45 seconds to become available AFTER the craft the A55 Kicker.  It will be tied to the same button on your keyboard or controller that you used to craft it (E on keyboard by default or the Y controller button)

The upgraded A55 Kicker moves on its own towards enemies first and asteroids secondly, but it always prioritizes smaller rocks in its range over larger asteroids.

The upgraded A55 Kicker fires approx 20% faster than the standard A55 Kicker.

The upgraded A55 Kicker is completely immune to the Kamikaze worm, the RSA shooter, and the VDS fired shots!  (It can still be destroyed by lightning ball shots from an end level boss or from your placed Zaxpoleon dynamite)

Other changes in this update:

- Zaxpoleon Dynamite will now destroy any G.E.O.S. gems in the explosion range.  Be careful with it!

- The A55 Kicker now helps you fight the end level boss ships as long as it survives the wave of asteroids with you.  Note that only ONE A55 kicker will come to the boss battle with you if you have two of them on a level.

- End level bosses now slowly repair damage to their ship over time.  Make sure to keep the pressure and damage on them!

- Vanquished End Level Boss ships now drop a good amount of resources and potentially other pickups such as dynamite, spi-rolls, or even a G.E.O.S. gem if you are fortunate!  You'll have exactly 20 seconds to collect dropped boss loot before the game moves you to the end level stat screen.

Some asteroids now have a higher chance than ever of dropping asteroids, especially the smallest chunks.  Keep in mind that only the asteroids that have a slight colored tint to them or the yellow bordered chunks have any chance of dropping resources.  Gray colored asteroids have almost a ZERO chance of dropping resources.

# Fixed a bug that caused a fatal error when the VDS would fire a missile at you.  

# Fixed an issue that caused the smallest asteroid chunks to be shattered when running into your ship while using the E.T. powerup.

The monster rocks are still being worked on.  I implemented them but wasn't happy with how they worked, so they will be added to Rock 'N Roll when I am happy with them.  I want to make sure I make them a lot of fun to bust up with real risk versus reward elements!

I think that's it.  Hope you enjoy the "Up Your A55" update!  Let me know in the comments below!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.99A - Trial & Error on UI Changes Leads To Sticking With Tried & True + Sadness Seeing the End..
notes.notes:
Tonight, I spent several hours working on simplifying the look of the UI, using symbols in the place of words such such as an actual G.E.O.S Gem instead of  "G.E.O.S Gems" and a stop watch icon instead of the word "Timer" etc...  I adjusted all the code to make everything tidy and neat.  I made all the number text for the readouts a nice off white color so it all looked in unison.

..And after all my hours of trial and error, I hated it!  I just didn't like it as much myself, so I put it all back, lol.  That's the great thing about developing software, you are in complete control of these details in the end, but please take a look below to get an idea of what I tried to do and tell me your thoughts below!  :-)  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/488984f230fe609009f71888de482ac07703029b.png[/img]

But one thing I did change was I made all the asteroids and enemies and your player ship wrap around from the bottom edge of the UI to the bottom of the screen.  This makes it look a lot cleaner I think and prevents asteroids and you from being hidden or jumbled in with the UI words and numbers.

I also made your player trail when thrusting more vibrant and stand out more, as well as enhancing the look of your fired shots with a little more color.  Your shots are easier to see now and hey.. it's not much, but it's something.  

Anyhow, the monster rocks and tutorial mode is all coming.  I'll likely make the tutorial next and then work on the what I have planned for the Monster rocks coming!  If you didn't see the "hype pic", it's right here...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/0dbc85f16d1b40ed13b4c794c60bbc95ffcc2638.png[/img]

I think the players are going to love the monster rocks when I get what I have planned added and coded in.

One thing I am beginning to see however is that I've just about done all I can with Rock 'N Roll.  I mean as far as adding new stuff and making it more and more complex.  I realized this when I started working on my tutorial mode yesterday and the first part of the tutorial will have a player be invulnerable to the rocks to begin.  And this made me wonder why I didn't have an "invisibility" power-up in my game yet.  And so my 14th power-up which I call "E.T." for Evanescent Tranquility was born and added to this game yesterday.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/3867753d15702ee22481bf46723cad26dca6b35a.png[/img]

But before I simply made "E.T" just another power-up, I brainstormed all the possibilities on how E.T. could be so much more than just another power-up.  I toyed with the idea of making it a whole new "risk vs reward" aspect of the game.  I almost started programming E.T. as a whole new function tired to the L2 button on the controller or SHIFT by default on the keyboard. It would players to simply use E.T. anytime they wanted to or got in a dangerous predicament in the game.  Ghosting to avoid damage.  Anytime.  But I had a catch in mind with a cost for using it being 100 score points for using it, and that cost doubling each additional second you used it on each level.  If you ever had too low of a score to pay the cost for using it and panicked or tried to use it anyhow, it would result in a chance of exploding.  Risk VS Reward.

Another button for players to learn.  Another function of the game to further complicate my game.  I pictured new players buying my game and loving being able to use ET at first passing through asteroids unharmed until they blew themselves up and rage quit my game just moments later in anger.  I imaged negative feedback and posts about how complex my old school retro game was and questions as to why I didn't just keep my game simple.  I laughed at myself and decided then and there to just make it the 14th power-up and work just like most of the other power-ups already in like Rapid Fire and Cannon Ball, a cool little power-up to use from time to time expiring when the power-up timer ran out. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/e52073dbc51e20f0c210e8869bf283f91ddef672.jpg[/img]

Looking back now, I truly am shocked at how far my first game here has come.  Rock 'N Roll started with just a few power-ups and the main idea of the Spi-Roll attack to get out of harms way, my twist on the old school arcade games hyperspace that teleported you to a random location on the screen.  

I never had any idea that in the coming weeks and months, I'd come up with everything I've already added.  

Resources and collecting them to sell for game cash or score points and upgrades in an upgrade space station.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/4b5babb0ab2ac0a50d31559766432afdfb498f1d.png[/img]

I never dreamed then that I'd soon come up with earning G.E.O.S. gems (Galactic Emeralds of Sacrifice) to save the earth or M.E.S.A. (Mass Energy Shield Augmentation) to shield you from death.  

And I certainly wouldn't have bet that I'd come up with the idea of a duct taped aluminum beer can as a little turret buddy to help you out that I'd end up naming the "A55 Kicker"

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/f98a1a09606f99e8b01455947530dc80fb31a952.png[/img]

Other ideas that spawned and were added to the game were the "Mother Sucker" power-up to allow you to suck up resources as you blast asteroids and the recently added "Zaxpoleon Dynamite" to allow you to place sticks of dynamite suspended in space to blow things all to hell, including yourself if you're not careful!

..And just yesterday, I added "E.T." to my game (Evanescent Tranquility).  And soon, I will add those insanely ridiculous-in-size "monster rocks" and I know people are going to love them because combined with the Zaxpoleon Dynamite, OMG.. it's gonna be a ton of fun.  Oh yeah!  

But with that, I am starting to see that I've about run Rock 'N Roll as far as it should really be taken with new stuff.  Sure, I'll patch it and tweak and balance things for as long as it's a product available for purchase on Steam.  Rock 'N Roll is my baby.  My first published game.  It might not be Call of Duty or PubG but it's still my first born child of code and I'm happy to say that I did it.  For someone that has never taken a course or even read a book about coding, I'm proud of this game and what I've accomplished.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/0ce77bef3957ab0a15b9484346176e4926ddb61a.png[/img]

I owe a huge "thank you" the the developers and company behind Game Maker Studio as without that excellent engine, it wouldn't have been nearly so possible for me.  I highly recommend the Game Maker Studio to anyone out there looking to make their game they've dreamed of making for years a reality. (and Game Maker Studio 2 looks amazing as well, I'll likely get my hands on it in the near future)

I've got new ideas for new games but it's hard to leave and stop trying to make your first born mess of code better and better and better.  But it's almost time to move on and just keep on eye on this first child of code, tweaking and fixing it when it needs a little developer love.

My only hope is that just a few people try my game and enjoy playing it even half was much as I enjoyed developing it.  That's not to say that it hasn't made me want to pull my hair out a few times, but the reward has definitely been worth the trouble.

Alright, lol... I'm done blabbing in text..  /end.wall.of.text = 49152.  :-D

Have fun out there.   Enjoy your gaming.. or whatever it is that you do.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/3867753d15702ee22481bf46723cad26dca6b35a.png[/img]

But before I simply made "E.T" just another power-up, I brainstormed all the possibilities on how E.T. could be so much more than just another power-up.  I toyed with the idea of making it a whole new "risk vs reward" aspect of the game.  I almost started programming E.T. as a whole new function tired to the L2 button on the controller or SHIFT by default on the keyboard. It would players to simply use E.T. anytime they wanted to or got in a dangerous predicament in the game.  Ghosting to avoid damage.  Anytime.  But I had a catch in mind with a cost for using it being 100 score points for using it, and that cost doubling each additional second you used it on each level.  If you ever had too low of a score to pay the cost for using it and panicked or tried to use it anyhow, it would result in a chance of exploding.  Risk VS Reward.

Another button for players to learn.  Another function of the game to further complicate my game.  I pictured new players buying my game and loving being able to use ET at first passing through asteroids unharmed until they blew themselves up and rage quit my game just moments later in anger.  I imaged negative feedback and posts about how complex my old school retro game was and questions as to why I didn't just keep my game simple.  I laughed at myself and decided then and there to just make it the 14th power-up and work just like most of the other power-ups already in like Rapid Fire and Cannon Ball, a cool little power-up to use from time to time expiring when the power-up timer ran out. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/e52073dbc51e20f0c210e8869bf283f91ddef672.jpg[/img]

Looking back now, I truly am shocked at how far my first game here has come.  Rock 'N Roll started with just a few power-ups and the main idea of the Spi-Roll attack to get out of harms way, my twist on the old school arcade games hyperspace that teleported you to a random location on the screen.  

I never had any idea that in the coming weeks and months, I'd come up with everything I've already added.  

Resources and collecting them to sell for game cash or score points and upgrades in an upgrade space station.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/4b5babb0ab2ac0a50d31559766432afdfb498f1d.png[/img]

I never dreamed then that I'd soon come up with earning G.E.O.S. gems (Galactic Emeralds of Sacrifice) to save the earth or M.E.S.A. (Mass Energy Shield Augmentation) to shield you from death.  

And I certainly wouldn't have bet that I'd come up with the idea of a duct taped aluminum beer can as a little turret buddy to help you out that I'd end up naming the "A55 Kicker"

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/f98a1a09606f99e8b01455947530dc80fb31a952.png[/img]

Other ideas that spawned and were added to the game were the "Mother Sucker" power-up to allow you to suck up resources as you blast asteroids and the recently added "Zaxpoleon Dynamite" to allow you to place sticks of dynamite suspended in space to blow things all to hell, including yourself if you're not careful!

..And just yesterday, I added "E.T." to my game (Evanescent Tranquility).  And soon, I will add those insanely ridiculous-in-size "monster rocks" and I know people are going to love them because combined with the Zaxpoleon Dynamite, OMG.. it's gonna be a ton of fun.  Oh yeah!  

But with that, I am starting to see that I've about run Rock 'N Roll as far as it should really be taken with new stuff.  Sure, I'll patch it and tweak and balance things for as long as it's a product available for purchase on Steam.  Rock 'N Roll is my baby.  My first published game.  It might not be Call of Duty or PubG but it's still my first born child of code and I'm happy to say that I did it.  For someone that has never taken a course or even read a book about coding, I'm proud of this game and what I've accomplished.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/0ce77bef3957ab0a15b9484346176e4926ddb61a.png[/img]

I owe a huge "thank you" the the developers and company behind Game Maker Studio as without that excellent engine, it wouldn't have been nearly so possible for me.  I highly recommend the Game Maker Studio to anyone out there looking to make their game they've dreamed of making for years a reality. (and Game Maker Studio 2 looks amazing as well, I'll likely get my hands on it in the near future)

I've got new ideas for new games but it's hard to leave and stop trying to make your first born mess of code better and better and better.  But it's almost time to move on and just keep on eye on this first child of code, tweaking and fixing it when it needs a little developer love.

My only hope is that just a few people try my game and enjoy playing it even half was much as I enjoyed developing it.  That's not to say that it hasn't made me want to pull my hair out a few times, but the reward has definitely been worth the trouble.

Alright, lol... I'm done blabbing in text..  /end.wall.of.text = 49152.  :-D

Have fun out there.   Enjoy your gaming.. or whatever it is that you do.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.98 - Customizable Keyboard Settings is Live!
notes.notes:
This update should make a few of you Rock 'N Rollers out there really happy.

You can now completely set your own custom keys on the keyboard to whatever keys you desire, and these keys are saved on your local computer for you and retrieved every time you launch the game!

Resetting the keys to the default settings is also easily done by simply clicking the "reset to default" area in the Controls menu item.

All game modes should now tell you what button to press to continue or re-spawn or place bombs or whatever the message is for.  Previously the game gave messages such as "Press A on Controller or ENTER to Continue" and the code has now been changed to give messages based on the most current method of control used.  For example, you might start playing a game with the keyboard and see messages such as "Press Space to continue" and in mid-game start using a controller and the game should start giving you messages that apply to controller keys used.

A few other changes in this patch are dynamite nerfs to both the end level bosses and the VDS.  The dynamite was simply way too strong and way stronger than I intended when creating the Zaxpoleon Dynamite.  Neither the VDS or enemy bosses should be able to be completely destroyed by a single dynamite, it should take several or additional attacks from a different source to take these enemies out.

The thrust sound of your ship was also reduced to be much quieter than before, and a few other sound effects were adjusted as well (usually lower).

As always, please let me know in the comments below or in the forums for this game what your thoughts are, or if you come across any bugs or issues with this new patch.

Have a great weekend!

notes.notes:
This update brings the first real audio and resolution settings to Rock 'N Roll. Until the next update, Have Fun out there and... Rock on!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.96 - Flashier Resources, Bypassed Intro Screen, Nerfed Boss Shots, More!
notes.notes:
In this update, the following things have been changed in game..

* All resources have been given unique but much flashier glows to help them stand out from the asteroids.  Some resources seem to pulsate a single color now, while others flash multiple colors.

* End level boss fired balls of lightning at you now give you a full second of time from the time you hear the warning fire "chug" sound until the shot is fired.  Also changed is that now these boss shots are much more likely to shoot at where your ship position was when the "chug" warning sound is heard instead of the current position of your ship at the time the boss shot occurs.  This means that if you move out of harms way when you hear the warning "chug" sound, you'll be much less likely to get hit by the ball of lightning fired at you!

* When restarting a new game from the end game stats screen on the main game mode, the game will now send you directly to the main menu screen rather than sending you back to the game introduction screen.

* Dynamite explosions used against the end level boss ships now explode correctly.  The damage hasn't changed, but the explosion effect looks cooler now!

* The font used for the word "Zaxpoleon" in Zaxpoleon Dynamite on the UI for the main game mode now matches the font used in all other UI status indicators.

* End level boss ships now gain slightly more health as you progress through the levels, as well as get more accurate on their fired shots at you.

* A new crafting sound has been added when you craft an A55 Kicker (no sound was heard for this event previously)


More changes are coming.  Please feel free to make suggestions or leave feedback on your thoughts and opinions of this game as user feedback is invaluable information to me as a new game developer here on Steam.

Thanks for reading and have fun out there!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.95 - Two Week 95 Cent Sale! ..End Level Bosses & Zaxpoleon Dynamite Is In NOW!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Rock 'N Roll version 1.95 for which I will be offering a whopping 84% discount for a full two weeks (Jan 15 until Jan 29) which means you can land this new updated version of Rock 'N Roll for less than a dollar!  (..Just 95 cents in USD!)

"Zaxpoleon Dynamite" is in NOW!  Watch how it works in this video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l9qnyjZ3idc
This is an early version of the upcoming version 2.0 and now has the implemenation of both "Zaxpoleon Dynamite" and end level bosses who will try and destroy you to steal your valuable resources that you've collected!

I fully expect that there will be many balance changes and a few bugs to fix before I release version 2.0.  Not in yet, but still in the works is a full featured Tutorial mode to walk new players into the game as it will showcase all the features. power-ups, and 'how to survive' in the game.

With this release, I have reset all high scores for the normal Rock 'N Roll game mode.  (The global high score list for Hard Rock mode is left as is) and I want to let everyone know that with balance changes expected before I release version 2.0, the high scores for the main game mode will VERY LIKELY BE RESET AGAIN.  It doesn't make any sense to keep a high score list for an obsolete version of the game where so many major scoring changes and the entire balance of the game has changed so much.  

The big scoring change with version 1.95 is a massive reduction in points scored for saving the Earth with a G.E.O.S. gem at the end of the game.  Previously, the scoring was 100 million points multiplied by the difficulty you chose at the start of the game.  This has now been changed to 250,000 points multiplied by the difficulty chosen.  With this change, it should now be possible to set a top high score without 'needing' to hit the jackpot at the end of the game.  I think this is a much better way to score saving the Earth and won't make players feel quite so doomed for playing really well but just not getting lucky with their G.E.O.S. gem selections.

"Zaxpoleon Dynamite" is now in and can spawn during waves of asteroids just like any other power-up.  If collected, you'll earn a +1 counter on your dynamite which is displayed in the upper left UI just to the right of your score.  To place a dynamite, simply press either your X controller button or your TAB button on your keyboard.  The placed dynamite will be reflected by a spinning star and you'll hear the tick down until it explodes.  Be careful that you avoid the area when it does explode or you'll lose a life!  (Note that even MESA shield protection will NOT prevent you from blowing yourself up with your own dynamite!)  

Zaxpoleon Dynamite can also be purchased with earned cash at the Galactic Upgrade Station between levels.

End level bosses will now spawn once you destroy the last asteroid on each wave and will look to destroy you.  You can use dynamite or shots to try and destroy the boss ships and if you have an A55 kicker at the end of a level, it will also help you as long as it is within shooting range of the boss ship!  Pay attention to the indicator shown on the Boss Health at the top middle UI as the bar will show you which side of the boss ship is most vulnerable to your attacks.  This vulnerable side will likely change many times during your battle.  The boss will also make a low 'chug' sound before it shoots a ball of lightning at you, so you can use this as a warning to get out of harms way!

Other changes include a new layout to show all keyboard and controller controls in the "Game Controls" screen and a big increase to rotation speed  with the purchase of Rotation Speed upgrades at the Galactic Upgrade Station.  Note that rotation speed has already been drastically increased by  in version 1.50.  Adding additional rotation boost with rotation speed upgrades should really help players whip around at lightning speeds, especially if they choose to invest in it at the Galactic Upgrade Station.

Please post all your bugs, suggestions, and feedback either here or in the forums as your feedback is very valuable and will help me make a better and more enjoyable game for everyone who plays Rock 'N Roll!

I hope you enjoy the changes and additions to this game as well as the two week sale price to snag Rock 'N Roll for under a buck!

Thanks for reading, and thanks for playing.. Now get out there and show us how well YOU can "Rock 'N Roll"!  :-)

notes.title: Rock 'N Roll's Biggest Content Update is Coming! Level Bosses, Devastating Dynamite, and Bonus Rounds.. Oh My!
notes.notes:
Alright to anyone who enjoys my game out there..  

I am happy to announce that the biggest update ever is coming to Rock 'N Roll soon!  While I had hoped to push out this update in time for the New Year holiday, it's just not ready.  I've been hard at work however adding a lot to the game that I think will enhance it quite a lot.

If you've seen the last two trailers, then you know that I've hyped new enemy bosses coming to the game who will try and destroy you after you've cleared each level and collected resources from all the asteroids you've destroyed.  Also teased in a recent video is the all new "Zaxpoleon Dynamite" which is coming to allow you a powerful new method to doing massive damage quickly to both rocks and enemies.

Also coming and not yet teased in a video yet is all new bonus levels where you cannot take damage of any kind, and start with a single massive asteroid about 20 times bigger than the biggest in the game currently.  The goal of these bonus levels is to completely destroy these mega-rocks with nothing but Zaxpoleon dynamite which will spawn in abundance on the screen.  The faster you dynamite the mega-rock to oblivion, the higher your bonus score will be!

An all new tutorial mode is also planned to walk new players though progressive training to teach not only the basics of the game, but also advanced game techniques.

While all of this content is coming soon and "could be" patched in today, it's just not ready and to a point I am happy with yet.  Everything being added to the game changes the default game mode to such an extent that it completely changes the balance and scope completely.  It means that almost every aspect of the game needs re-balancing and lots of code re-worked.

Perhaps the best aspect of all of this new stuff is that all of this additional content is coming to Rock 'N Roll COMPLETELY FREE!  The idea with all of this new stuff is to give newer players a less challenging and more satisfying game experience, while enriching the game with more reasons to 'come back again and again' to all players of my game.

Look for a huge new update to Rock 'N Roll in the near future, when I am happy that's it's "ready".  While I'd love to give a specific date, all I can say at this point is that it shouldn't be too far out.  Weeks rather than months but it won't be "days" would be my best estimate today.

Also remember that the default normal game mode will be getting a Steam global high score reset once the new updates hit and are balanced and tweaked to a point where I am satisfied in giving Rock 'N Roll a version 2.0 stamp.

I wanted to update everyone on the status of this new content before 2018 hits and also wish that everyone out there has a happy and fulfilling new year!  Remember that when life gives you a "sad country song", often times your best remedy is a little dose of "Rock 'N Roll"!   ..Stay safe out there and have a blast with whatever it is that you do!  :-)

notes.notes:

notes.title: UPDATE 1.30 - Hard Rock Mode Time Fixes ..Plus 5 New Steam Achievements!
notes.notes:
The Hard Rock game mode has been in need of a little love since it was first created over just a few days of coding it back in October.

In this patch, the time has finally been fixed so that minutes and seconds are working correctly based on real time.  Some players might have felt like they survived for much longer in this mode than the game gave them credit for, and that would have been an accurate feeling.  

The time not accurately reflecting real time measurements was due to some computers lagging behind real time in the game.  Now the timer in the Hard Rock mode bases how long you last based 100% on real time measurements versus what the game calculated as time.  With time, even a small difference in a single second adds up over many seconds and this small inaccuracy magnified was what led to the time problems that needed addressed.

The G.E.O.S. progression bar, the G.E.O.S gem counter, and the "Ships" counter all on the upper right UI have been removed in this patch. Now you'll see a "Time Survived" counter to show you exactly how long you've lasted every second of your battle for survival in the Hard Rock game mode.

All Hard Rock time and score Steam achievements should also work correctly now with this patch. Also, five new Steam achievements have been added for the Hard Rock mode.  You now get a Steam achievement for lasting 10 minutes, 15 minutes, 20 minutes, and a whopping 30 minutes as well as for scoring 25,000 points.

Rock 'N Roll is far from perfect even as we speak today, but I believe that it continues to evolve and get better one patch at a time.

Have fun, and again, Happy Holidays to all!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.28 - Big Changes to Scoring For Saving the Earth AND Smasher & Cannon Ball Bug Fix!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.  This is a pretty big change to the scoring based on when you are successful at saving the Earth with a G.E.O.S. gem you collect in your games.

As I was about to play my game, I looked at the global high scores here on Steam to see that a couple of people having scored higher than my current 3rd best high score.  I saw a problem however when I checked out these scores.  While I usually play on difficulty 2 myself, I wondered if the two scores above me were obtained on difficulty 1, a much easier experience mainly because there is absolutely no threat of ever having to face the most deadly enemy in this game known as the VDS.  ..Perhaps though they played a higher difficulty and got such high scores because of higher scoring awarded in game for taking on the challenge of higher difficulties.  ..I just didn't know!

Update 1.28 changes that, and now it will be very obvious what difficulty was played by anyone who succeeds in the main objective of saving the Earth in the normal game mode.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/c24f38ffb7cee2a2603f48fe5c5b8dc12b1b8f4f.png[/img]

In the above game code, the code I changed in this update is shown.  The event where this code occurs is just before the final statistics are shown on the end game screen.  The variable "global.saved" is only set to 7 at this point if the player succeeded in saving the Earth with a G.E.O.S. gem.  The variable "global.points" is the player score, and the variable "global.lvl" is the difficulty the player had selected before their game.

So where this code had previously just awarded 50 million points to the player if they saved the Earth regardless of what difficulty they had selected, you'll see that now the bonus for saving the earth is 100 million points multiplied by the difficulty they selected before their game.  (the * means 'multiply' in the line of code shown)

I think this change is a good change to the scoring that will help all people looking at the top scores to easily see on what difficulty each was achieved on.  It will also help encourage people to take on the challenge of higher difficulties if they want to be "the best of the best" on the Steam global high scores for this game.  Keep in mind that this scoring only applies to games where you are successful in saving the Earth with a G.E.O.S. game.

There was also a bug fixed that would happen when you sometimes might have a Smasher or Cannon Ball power up and collect another power-up while in the middle of one of those power-ups that would end your Smasher or Cannon Ball power up early.  Hitting a power-up like K-OS while using one of these two power-ups could lead to a confusing and unexpected death!  This has been fixed by making collecting any power-up time power-up impossible while already using a Smasher or Cannon Ball.  Note that you should still be able to collect power-ups like an extra Spi-roll, an extra ship, MESA, an A-55 Kicker, and Mother Sucker while using either a Smasher or Cannon Ball power-up. 

Also changed in this update was the game information on the difficulty selection screen to give more detailed information about the importance of the G.E.O.S. gems and the new scoring system if you are successful at saving the Earth in your game.

As always, have fun when you "Rock 'N Roll" and Happy Holidays to you all!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.24 - Adjustments to Invulnerable Player and Asteroid Collisions..
notes.notes:
This update is just more adjustments to the collisions when you use either a Smasher power-up, a Cannon Ball power-up, or a Spi-Roll attack against asteroids.  Many complex formulas now try and determine the asteroid breaking and each pieces direction and speed.  

The problem I had back before I started working on these collisions before update 1.23 is that too often when using one of those methods I mentioned above is that your speed was faster than all of the break-off chunks causing you to not even see the asteroid breaking up.  As a result, this caused using the Spi-Roll attack, the Cannon Ball power up and the Smasher Power-up as well to be over-powered in a way as breaking asteroids using these methods was too rewarding point wise, and didn't present enough additional threat.  (Remember my whole "Risk VS Reward" element being the most important aspect of my game from the very beginning of development)

After this update, I think it is now better than it was, but more adjustments to these collisions will likely be made in the near future.  

I've heard that a good developer is just never happy with his game and these refinements go to show that might just be true.  I'm starting to think that I'll never be 100% happy with the code and aspects of my game as it seems there's always something I want to adjust, balance, add, fix, or alter.  

Hopefully this determination to make Rock 'N Roll better all the time will serve the people who play and experience my game well.

As always.. Rock On and Enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE (Still 1.23).. Early Changes to The Way Asteroids Break Down When Hit By Your Ship at High Velocity...
notes.notes:
Just updated some changes to the existing code to try and change the behavior of asteroids when they are smashed with your ship at high velocity is in the Cannonball power-up, the Smasher Power-up, and a Spi-roll attack.

Before now, bigger asteroids far too often just looked to immediately be vanquished when using one of the above mentioned power-ups or a Spi-roll attack.  I look to start changing that and making it riskier to try and use one of these methods to break an asteroid down.  

So in this updated build which is live now, at both higher difficulties and especially at higher levels during your game (higher waves), you'll notice that smashing into a larger asteroid with any of these methods will now both look better and create more danger for you in much faster moving smaller rocks.  Remember that the big theme behind my game from the very first build of my game months before it hit early access on Steam was 'Risk VS Reward".  You should now start needing to think a little bit before trying to dismantle a large asteroid very quickly.  Sure it has high rewards and massive points and quick resource drops, but it now has a price in much more dangerous smaller asteroids flying much faster when you use your ship to break apart a space rock.

This is just more in my long list of patches and updates to make Rock 'N Roll both look and play better.  It will very likely need more tweaks but I think it's already better than it was.  I'm sure you'll notice a difference especially as you start moving deeper into your waves of asteroids as you progress now.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.21 - Hard Rock Mode Gets Some Depth and Its own Steam Leaderboard
notes.notes:
Okay everyone, update 1.21 sees quite a few simple but nice additions and changes to the "Hard Rock" game mode, so let's go over them..

* Bombs can now be collected as random spawns in the game and saved up. * You now get points just for surviving and staying alive!  1 point per second is scored simply for just existing in the game.

* Asteroids destroyed by you (by any method) are now scored at  a value of 1.5 points per second from the time the asteroid was spawned shooting at you in the game.  So letting an asteroid bounce around the screen and doing fancy spins and circle 8's around it might look cool but it doesn't mean that it will be worth any more points when you take it out.  Again, the value of each asteroid is based on the second it is spawned into the game shooting at you.  So taking out an asteroid spawned at second #10 of the game is worth 15 points, while shooting down an asteroid that shoots at you at exactly 1 minute into the game is worth 90 points.

* The G.E.O.S. progression bar when filled will still cause a G.E.O.S. gem to spawn with the next asteroid blasted, and will be worth 5,000 points if you pick it up before is shatters (about 40 seconds)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.17 - More Game Balancing.. Now Double Accuracy Bonus Points, More Movment While Shooting Rocks Points, A55 Kicker Balancing.. +More!
notes.notes:
Alright, I've been hard at work all day today for about ten hours straight trying to balance Rock 'N Roll, get all the formulas and calculations better with all the new changes and additions to the game recently..  This IS a vital part of making a good and fun game that you want to return to again and again!  

So anyhow, let's get to the changes made for Update 1.17...

* I've boosted the accuracy bonus points again so that it feels more fair when compared to the time bonuses which have been pretty gigantic at times compared to taking careful aim with your shots.  I'm not at more then double the accuracy rewards over what this game saw just yesterday.

* Another 40% increase in points are awarded immediately to you for the Risk VS Reward action of thrusting while shooting and hitting asteroids.  The faster you are moving and the smaller the asteroid hit with your bullet, the greater the bonus.  This total is now given to you on the "Level Complete" statistics screen between levels.  Keep in mind that this bonus shown is already given to you immediately when you hit asteroids with bullets while moving real time, but it's just nice to see how many points you did earn by being a dare devil.

* Before this update, extra lives were earned either by picking up the bonus life power-up (rare drop) during the action, or by scoring 20,000...50,000, and every 50,000 points thereafter.  That is not changing until you pass 1 million points.  Once you pass a million points in a game, the requirement to get an extra life moves from every 50,000 points to every 100,000 points.

* The A55 Kicker fire rate has been changed.  Its firing rate will now vary in speed based on what level (wave) you are on when you spawn it (or pick up the A55 Kicker power-up)  At level 1, you'll see about a 40% slower firing rate, and each level will slowly increase it's firing rate.  The firing rate seen before this update will be matched at level 7, and each successive level will slowly increase its rate of fire until it maxes out at level 16 at which point it would be firing more than twice the speed it always fired at before this patch.  So basically, the rate of fire is nerfed until you reach level 7, and buffed after level 7.  Note that the difficulty you choose to begin the game has no effect on this firing rate, it's all based on what wave or level you are on.

*The A55 Kicker was also OP against the enemies killing them effortlessly as long as they were within the A55's range.  The A55 will now sometimes barely miss the Red Shooter Alien and the Kamikaze worm but will still do extremely well when firing against the VDS.  Keep in mind that if the VDS spawns with an A55 Kicker on your screen, unless you save your little buddy, the VDS will very likely kill it based on having precise aim and a much longer firing distance than your little aluminum beer can friend.  Protect it and kill the VDS before it kills your friend!  ;-)

* Tweaks were made to the Cannonball power-up when you have purchased additional power-up time at the Galactic Upgrade Station between levels.  Now for every additional second of power-up time you purchase, the Cannonball power-up will send you flying at incrementally faster speeds when launched from the cannon power-up pick up.  This means that if you were to max out the power-up timer at 60 seconds, picking up the Cannonball power-up would launch you at double the speed!  Wow!  ..I hope this doesn't send anyones ship flying through their monitor and into their real life home!  :-P

Remember to have fun!  I hope you enjoy the game and all the work I'm putting into this little game.  :-)
