notes.title: UPDATE 1.16 - Bouncer Shots No Longer Spikes (or Hurts) Your Shot Accuracy! Level Complete Addional Stats, Shots Hit While Moving Bonus Points Increased!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.  

With Update 1.16, Bouncer Shots will NO LONGER BE COUNTED AS AN "ACCURATE SHOT" and help you score an "accuracy bonus" on the Level Complete screen between levels.  Even one Bouncer Shots power-up could spike what would have been a 15% accuracy way up close to 40% or even 50% giving you massive bonus points that you really didn't deserve just because you got lucky with a Bouncer Shots power-up pick up.  The accuracy bonus was intended to reward careful shots, and Bouncer Shots helping spike your shot accuracy just didn't make sense.

Please note to anyone who played for the Accuracy Bonus before now that you no longer need to avoid the Bouncer Shots power-up because using it would penalize your shot accuracy.  This has also been fixed with this update.  Any shots fired while using the Bouncer Shots power-up simply don't count for accuracy and they also don't count against your accuracy.  ONLY SHOTS FIRED WHILE NOT USING THE BOUNCER SHOTS POWER-UP COUNT TOWARDS YOUR SHOT ACCURACY at the end of each wave so that you'll always see a very fair actual accuracy on the shots your fired during the level and be fairly rewarded if your accuracy was at or above 25%

I also wanted to show players how many points their little A55 Kickers were helping them score on each level, so now in the stats after each level completed, you'll see how many of your points that wave were scored for you by your little friend.  It will also tell you the percentage of your total points earned that you A55 Kicker scored for you.

Also on every Level Complete statistics screen, you'll now see how many bonus points you scored for hitting asteroids with you bullets while moving.  Big points can be earned by simply moving and hitting asteroids.  The faster you are moving while you hit an asteroid, the more bonus points you'll get.  The smaller the asteroids are that you hit while moving, the more bonus points you'll get as well.  These moving while hitting asteroids points are also magnified slightly by what level you have progressed to, so for example if you are moving at a speed of 75 and hit a small asteroid on level (wave) 1, it won't be worth as many bonus points moving at the same speed and hitting the same size asteroid on wave 7.

The points have also been increased about 8x for this movement while hitting asteroids over what they originally were in update 1.15.  This may need tweaking and balance because it's a whole new game mechanic just added today.  The idea here continues to be based on my whole "Risk VS Reward" idea that so much of my game revolves around.  You "should" score more points by destroying asteroids while thrusting and dodging than if you are simply planted still in the middle of the screen firing away.  Also, remember that I increased the base minimum rotation speed in update 1.15, so I want to make sure that moving while blasting and hitting asteroids is rewarded. 

Remember that these movement bonus points are ONLY scored if you hit an asteroid with your BULLETS WHILE MOVING.  Any smasher hit, Spi-roll hit, Cannonball hit etc with your ship WILL NOT give you these bonus points.  The asteroids must be destroyed with your ships "bullets" for these points to be rewarded.  Also note that even though these bonus points are shown on the Level Complete screen, it's just an information statistic.  All movement bonus points are given to you immediately when you score the hits while moving, so you don't have to complete a level to get these specific bonus points like the Time-To-Beat Bonus and the Accuracy Bonus.

I think you'll like these two new statistics shown on each Level Complete screen to get a better idea of where your points are coming from when using the A55 Kicker and how many bonus points you're actually scoring with your wild and crazy movement and shooting each wave.  

Helpful Hint:  Remember to hold down your fire button while using the smasher and especially the Cannonball power-ups now as hitting any asteroids while moving at those high movement speeds can definitely help you rack up points!

As always, have fun and remember.. This isn't your daddy's Rock 'N Roll!  Pump up the jam.. Pump up the thrust speeds, and Pump up those point totals.. Pump it up, ahhh Pump it up now!   :-)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.15 - More Balancing & Bouncer Shots Changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  I hope that you are enjoying all the recent changes and additions to Rock 'N Roll!  Update 1.15 brings with it a couple of important
changes to how to your games will work as far as game balance and how the
Smasher power up looks differently than before..

Here is the NEW SMASHER look which when seen resembles a mallet or hammer smashing a rock into pieces:  
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/7b2d7569074a0d5bb77cfd1fa1e34d22dd872c85.png[/img]

Here are the important balance changes made to the game which will very likely not only affect your scores, but also how well you perform while playing:

BOUNCER SHOT CHANGE:

Bouncer Shots now work much more closely to what was originally intended.  Before this patch, you could fire shots around the screen and each bullet would bounce off the edge of the screen until an asteroid or enemy was hit.  The unintended problem was that once something was hit by a single bullet, all of your bullets on screen would disappear and you'd need to fire more bullets again.  

Bouncer shots now will now fire bullets and when something is hit by one of your bullets, it will no longer cause all the rest of your bullets on the screen to disappear.  The result of this change is a MUCH different (and more powerful power-up) as your bullets fired with Bouncer Shots will correctly bounce all around the screen and each bullet will continue bouncing around the screen until it either hits an enemy or an asteroid OR until the Bouncer Shots power-up time ends.  When the power-up time is over, all bullets currently bouncing around on the screen will then be removed from play.

--------------

BASE ROTATION SPEED WHILE NOT THRUSTING HAS BEEN INCREASED:

You minimum rotation speed (while not moving) has been increased by about 7% from the start of the game to provide you a little faster movement when needed.  Keep in mind that much faster rotation speeds both while thrusting and not moving forward is available in the Ship Upgrade station between levels for a cost.  Also remember that you will always be able to rotate your ship much faster while thrusting forward and the faster you thrust forward, that faster your rotation speed will be magnified.

--------------

ACCURACY BONUS AFTER EACH LEVEL HAS BEEN INCREASED:

The accuracy bonus has been beefed up by about 30% to give you a heftier bonus for scoring over a 25% accuracy on any given level.  Also note that using the bouncer shots power-up as of this update will help you score a much higher accuracy because each bullet will not miss now and will continue bouncing around until it hits something or until the power-up ends.

--------------

MORE POINTS FOR SHOOTING ASTEROIDS WHILE MOVING:

You'll now be award more points for moving while shooting asteroids.  The faster you are moving when you shoot an asteroid, and the smaller the asteroid is while moving, the bigger the bonus.  This only applies to your bullets hitting asteroids, ie smashing an asteroid with a Spi-Roll or a power-up such as smasher or cannonball with your ship will NOT give you bonus points.  The A55 Kicker hitting asteroids while it is moving will also not score you any more bonus points, as this bonus only applies to YOU and your bullets while you are moving.

--------------

END OF LEVEL TIME TO BEAT IS MODIFIED BY A55 KICKER ASSISTANCE:

If you have an A55 Kicker helping you blast asteroids, your level time to beat (to score a time bonus) will be reduced by the amount of time you had an A55 Kicker helping you out.  If you have two A55 Kickers, the time you had each one helping you will be calculated and reduce your goal time for a bonus even more.  

Not that power-ups such as Rapid Fire, Smasher, and Cannonball used during the level will NOT affect or reduce your goal time, so these are great power-ups to use to clear rocks quickly and help you get this bonus!

--------------

RESOURCE VALUES IS NOW MUCH LESS PREDICTABLE:

The points value and cash values of each resource sold at the Galactic Selling Station has been changed to be much less predictable than before.  You'll notice that each resource now has a much bigger variance each time you visit for both point values and cash values than ever.  This should stop the overall predictability of which ones are "better to sell for points" and which ones are always "better to sell for cash". notes.title: UPDATE 1.12 - Game Has Been Nerfed! - Slower Asteroids & Game Balancing!
notes.notes:
The asteroids flying at sonic speeds after just a few levels of progression has been nerfed quite a bit and I think players will definitely notice that life has gotten much easier with this patch.  

Keep in mind that more asteroids are still likely to spawn as you progress through the waves of rocks, and their speed will still increase as you advance, however the overall speed should progress much slower with this patch.  These changes will be more noticeable the higher the difficulty you choose to start the game, but every difficulty level should notice a lot easier time dodging rocks as you progress.

A unintended issue with the higher tier resources like Rhodium and Osmium spawning too frequently has been resolved and put back where it was before the A55 Kicker was introduced.  The problem was caused when I added a slight chance of asteroids dropping the exact resource you need to craft the A55 Kicker and what was happening sometimes is that the higher tier resources were also spawning unintentionally due to a goofy mistake made in my code.  This should be resolved now.

A few other minor tweaks and A55 bouncing off asteroids mechanics were made, and will likely continue to be made until I'm really happy with it.  Getting really believable bounces off asteroids with the A55 kicker has been a little tricky due to the odd shapes of the asteroids as well as the A55 kicker, but hopefully I can continue to perfect this over the coming patches.

Happy Rock 'N Rolling.. and please let me know your thoughts as this is BY FAR the BIGGEST GAME BALANCE PATCH since Rock 'N Roll launched in early access back on July 13th.  It should be a noticeably easier game than it was before, so higher scores from most players are likely!  Have Fun!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.10 - A few minor balances changed with the A55..
notes.notes:

notes.title: UPDATE 1.09 - The A55 KICKER is Live!
notes.notes:
It's time to kick some "A55" !!  ;-)

As promised earlier this week in my teaser seen below, the A55 Kicker is now live!  There's probably ..err most certainly more balancing and bugs to do to get it right, but it's here and ready to help you out!

A55 Kicker Teaser:

--- You can get your very own A55 Kicker two ways.. ---

1) By collecting a power up that says "A55 KIKR" which will spawn the aluminum beer can turret right where you collect the power-up 

2) By collecting the correct number of needed resources shown at the top of your screen just under the G.E.O.S. progression bar.  Each wave, the needed resource and number of those required might change.  Once you have collected the needed resources, it will tell you to simply press Y (on the controller) or your E key to launch the A55 Kicker where ever your ship is when you press the applicable button to spawn it.

- Crafting an A55 Kicker with resources USES those resources up, so you will not be able to sell those at the selling station, but any other resources you collected on the level can be sold as usual for either points or cash.

- Your A55 Kicker will never get ruined by hitting asteroids, it will bounce harmlessly away and continue blasting as asteroids and enemies if it sees them in range.

- Your A55 Kicker will be vanquished if it is shot by an enemy or if you end the level by shooting all the asteroids.

- If you notice your A55 kicker stopped and shooting nothing, it is because it isn't within shooting distance of an enemy or an asteroid.  You can, if you wish, simply go shoot it with your own shots to make it start moving through space so that it will start helping you out again.

- A power-up for the A55 will NEVER spawn if you have already crafted an A55 shooter that is still alive on the screen.  You can still craft a second A55 Kicker however if you have collected a power-up A55 Kicker and also collect the required resources to make one!  

- Only ONE A55 Kicker is craft-able per level (wave of asteroids)

- The A55 Kicker CANNOT be purchased at the Galactic Upgrade Station between levels.  You'll need to either collect and use resources to make one or get a lucky power up which is slightly under a 3% chance every time a power-up spawns on your screen.

Have FUN!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.06 - OMG! Free M.E.S.A. Protection, More RapidFire, ..What?!
notes.notes:
Several small bugs and problems resolved today causing innocent players to be ejected from the game and a "8008" score submitted to the Steam leaderboards as if they were cheating/hacking their Rock 'N Roll client (when they weren't).  Big thanks to Steam user odezma for finding and posting several of these issues today under the 1.05 patch announcement.  ..When issues like this are reported, it usually doesn't take me long at all to fix them and get a patch out for everyone, so please continue to report all bugs and issues found, especially if the game is kicking you out when you aren't hacking!  ..LOL.

Okay, on to the good news and why you probably clicked these 1.06 patch notes...  Yes!  You can now possibly get M.E.S.A. protection while blasting asteroids completely free if you are lucky.  The M.E.S.A. protection might spawn as a power-up and if you simply collect it with your ship, you'll have immediate M.E.S.A. protection!  ..Also note that a M.E.S.A power-up might spawn if you currently already have M.E.S.A. protection (that you've collected or purchased at the Galactic Space Upgrade Hub) and if that is the case, collect it again and you'll be protected on your next level (wave of asteroids)!  Wow!  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389580/4b5babb0ab2ac0a50d31559766432afdfb498f1d.png[/img]

notes.title: Rock 'N Roll Price Reduction with Early Access To Official Release!
notes.notes:
A long and very hard to make decision has been made to scratch my plans on adding local multiplayer to Rock 'N Roll and to take this game out of early access and declare it as a 'final product'.

It pains me and is a tough lesson in game development to watch my first published game on Steam, a game I only dreamt of making as a kid, have almost zero appeal in todays world.  Molding a child hood dream into a reality and actually getting it published on Steam only to see single digit sales in the six weeks after your games launch week is a tough pill to swallow.

The reasons why local multiplayer work was stopped also comes with seeing it just not working well when implemented and tested.  Frame rates suffer at times and the game would need to be redesigned almost completely to make local multiplayer work well and not just make a confusing mess of a game.  While my idea of adding local multiplayer sounded good initially while only creating a single player experience, it just doesn't seem worth completely redesigned and coding this game to support the idea.  

I firmly believe that this game in it's current state is very solid and a great value at the early access price point of $2.99 USD.  The reviews of those who played the game and wrote a review also seem to agree.  But to hopefully increase the very low demand currently on Rock 'N Roll, I have decided to move it from early access as it is now to a "ready" and "final" state and REDUCE the price by 33% from $2.99 USD to just $1.99 USD.  I hope that this decision increases the demand and exposure of my first published game on Steam while also giving this game a final declaration at it's most stable and best point of development.

This certainly doesn't mean that I will stop supporting my game.  As bugs are found by players and reported, I will work quickly to fix them, and I will continue to take any ideas, suggestions and feedback to heart.

If this game unexpectedly starts to show some kind of demand here on Steam, I will also more than likely continue to add features, enemies, and trading cards to this game.  Trading cards have always been intended, but this game needs to see a LOT more demand on Steam before Steam will authorize me to add them.  I hope that the reduction in price and stating that I am very happy with Rock 'N Roll as a single player experience as it is right now will help spur some level of interest here on Steam.

I sincerely appoligize to the few fans of this game currently who may have been anticipating the local multiplayer I had planned.  I truly did try to implement this feature before realizing it just wasn't going to work well without completely re-working the game.  With such low (almost zero) demand in the past several weeks for my game, changing it completely in hopes to add this feature didn't seem like the best path to take with Rock 'N Roll.

One tough lesson as been learned with game development on my first ever published game Rock 'N Roll.  I thought that making my dream game since I was a child would make a nice and refreshing addition to the current onslaught of zombie shooters, survival games, and asset flips.  Sometimes your dreams aren't the same as other people however, and perhaps I really need to study what people want rather than what I personally want to play if and when I ever publish another game in my future.

I am still very proud to say that I am VERY HAPPY with Rock 'N Roll as it is right now.  I believe that it is addicting to play, offers clutch moments of adrenaline inducing chaotic game play, and is a great value at the new lowered price of just $1.99 USD.  I guess my only disappointment is that more people don't seem to see or feel my passion for this type of a game.  

Be well, enjoy whatever game or games you play out there, and please feel free to post your thoughts below!  

-  Zax

This certainly doesn't mean that I will stop supporting my game.  As bugs are found by players and reported, I will work quickly to fix them, and I will continue to take any ideas, suggestions and feedback to heart.

If this game unexpectedly starts to show some kind of demand here on Steam, I will also more than likely continue to add features, enemies, and trading cards to this game.  Trading cards have always been intended, but this game needs to see a LOT more demand on Steam before Steam will authorize me to add them.  I hope that the reduction in price and stating that I am very happy with Rock 'N Roll as a single player experience as it is right now will help spur some level of interest here on Steam.

I sincerely appoligize to the few fans of this game currently who may have been anticipating the local multiplayer I had planned.  I truly did try to implement this feature before realizing it just wasn't going to work well without completely re-working the game.  With such low (almost zero) demand in the past several weeks for my game, changing it completely in hopes to add this feature didn't seem like the best path to take with Rock 'N Roll.

One tough lesson as been learned with game development on my first ever published game Rock 'N Roll.  I thought that making my dream game since I was a child would make a nice and refreshing addition to the current onslaught of zombie shooters, survival games, and asset flips.  Sometimes your dreams aren't the same as other people however, and perhaps I really need to study what people want rather than what I personally want to play if and when I ever publish another game in my future.

I am still very proud to say that I am VERY HAPPY with Rock 'N Roll as it is right now.  I believe that it is addicting to play, offers clutch moments of adrenaline inducing chaotic game play, and is a great value at the new lowered price of just $1.99 USD.  I guess my only disappointment is that more people don't seem to see or feel my passion for this type of a game.  

Be well, enjoy whatever game or games you play out there, and please feel free to post your thoughts below!  

-  Zax

notes.title: UPDATE 0.79 - Fixed Another Bug.. Allowing millions of points to be scored as an accuracy bonus!
notes.notes:
LOL.  My, my, my... how fun it is to see how people can play the game in crazy ways to try and break your game!  Thanks to my friend Thomas for breaking my game and exploiting millions of easy points by simply killing all the asteroids with power-ups and/or Spi-Roll attacks and not firing a single shot but scoring through-the-roof accuracy bonus points for it!  

This has (I believe) now been fixed...  I've completely redone the accuracy bonus calculations at the end of each level to award you for achieving at least a 25% accuracy on each level, but smacks from your ship no longer count (or diminish) your accuracy, only shots fired count towards your accuracy, as it should have been from the get-go.  Also, while you can score a lot of points for getting a high accuracy, you should actually have to "earn" such a bonus now.  (The bonus is calculated by both your accuracy percentage AND the total number of shots fired that hit an asteroid or an enemy now) and this is increased by small modifiers for doing this on both higher difficulty levels and on higher levels (waves of asteroids)

A lot of these fixes in both patches today were re-works of algotithms I put in place pretty quickly just to get the game functional way back when I started this project back in February.  Still, its great to see how my original code can be so greatly broken in ways I never thought of, and requiring me to actually code it "correctly" to not only be much more accurate calculations, but also to be less exploitable.

Keep trying to break the game!  Please let me know in the forums if you do break it, see a bug, expose an exploit, whatever!  I can't fix what I don't know is broken, so I appreciate all these broken game screenshots and reports as it only helps me make this game better.

Happy rock-hunting!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.78 - Easy Money/Points You Didn't Actually Earn No More! Big Bug Fixed + More!
notes.notes:
It's always interesting how silly of mistakes you can make trying to make the biggest game you've ever made and what is even more surprising to me is that I didn't notice it until playing the game just today.

Right before this game was launched on Steam in early access, I was trying to add a lot of stuff to the game with the G.E.O.S gems and the M.E.S.A. shields and much more, and in testing things, I changed some code causing the resources sold to not get reset properly between levels.  Since launch until I played today, I never really observed that these resources were not resetting correctly to zero once you sold them for either points of game cash.  This means that you could essentially be making MUCH more global cash and/or points than was ever intended by simply surviving a few levels because you could sell the same resources you already collected (and sold) in previous levels over and over and over and over..

Using this bug combined with the 5 million game cash option I put into the game "just for fun" back in update 0.71 on July 16th could mean big cash, big points, and a much easier game than was ever intended!  

Add in the option to purchase Spi-Rolls at a flat cost that didn't go up at all the more you purchased with no set limit, and it was possible to use the Greedy cheat option I added in update 0.71 to purchase more than 250 Spi-Roll attacks as early as the first Upgrade screen after beating just one wave of asteroids!  Having 250 or more Spi-Roll attacks could easily mean clearing out many levels without even trying, just spamming the Spi-Roll attack keys until the level was clear with minimal risk.

So to resolve these problems, I've made a lot of decisions and changes in this update...

I decided not to put in a timer restricting players ability to use consecutive Spi-Roll attacks because there is already a built in algorithm I coded in the game to increase a players risk for using this strategy.  Doing this will increase your "hurl away" speed exponentially to more times you use Spi-Roll attacks in succession, thus greatly increasing your risk of getting thrown into an asteroid.  I felt that this is a risk the player should have an option of taking if they so choose as long as they have enough Spi-Rolls to do so.

So here we go...  CHANGES made in this update:

- The optional "Greedy" cheat is still in the game from the introduction screen  just as before and still accessed by holding CTRL and hitting the "G" key on that introduction screen.  However, the amount given to you is now $500,000 game cash versus the old $5,000,000.  I feel that this is still enough to help players out, but not enough to allow them to make the game unbalanced too early on in their favor.

- Resources are now properly reset when you sell them at each Selling screen at the Galactic Space Hub.  This means that you'll likely notice a much slower cash flow than before if you've been able to advance a few levels and perhaps wondered "Wow, I just made bank that level!".  This is now fixed and working properly as it should.

- To award players for advancing to higher levels of the game and beating levels of asteroids, you'll now notice a small but exponentially growing value to all resources the further you advance in the game.  The resources you collect and sell from level 1 (wave 1) won't be nearly as much as the same resources collected and sold from wave 10.. should you make it that far.  To make this even more interesting, the score point values for resources will grow at almost double the rate of game cash value for resources.

- Spi-Rolls can still be purchased without limits at the Upgrade screen between levels as long as you have the game cash required to buy them, however each additional Spi-Roll purchased now increases the cost by a small amount if you have purchased ten or less at the same upgrade screen.  Purchasing more than ten Spi-Roll attacks will cause the additional cost of each one purchased to increae even more than the first ten additional Spi-Rolls purchased.  The cost of Spi-Rolls will reset to a random but low cost again once you defeat another level and return to the Upgrade screen.

- Enemies will now spawn much less frequently than before, especially on difficulty 1.  Again remember in the last patch 0.77 I also made it impossible to ever see the VDS if you choose difficulty 1.  The further you advance into the game, the more frequently enemies can spawn however.. even at difficulty 1.

- There is still no limit on the number of extra ships you can obtain in the game, you'll get an extra ship at 20,000 points, at 50,000 points, and at every 50,000 points afterwards (100k, 150, 200k, 250k, 300k and so on..)  I feel that the game does a good enough job of increasing the challenge the further you progress.  Also note that extra ships can be collected on rare power-up spawns during your gameplay.

- The iron resource has been given a little more "glitter" to make it look a little more like a collectible versus a small asteroid.

It's early access, and this is exactly why I chose to release this game in early access to give me plenty of time to fix issues, improve the game, and balance the game until I feel that it is a very solid and finished game.  While I'm sure that these issues fixed in this patch allowed a few Steam achievements to be set that really shouldn't have been awarded, I'm not going to reset the Steam achievements until this game comes out of early access.  Steam achievements WILL definitely be reset when I bring Rock 'N Roll out of early access, but we are likely to be a good few months away from that day.

I hope you all are enjoying the game and I think people will feel the changes made in this patch feel more authentic as like you're actually getting the score points and/or game cash you deserve now.  I also feel that there is a much greater difference after update 0.77 and this update 0.78 between the difficulties you choose from the start.  Difficulty 1 should be much more forgiving now than ever before and I think this is great because it will allow people to get a good feel for the game and the controls before taking on a stiffer challenge.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.77 - Rock 'N Roll Now Much Easier on Difficulty 1 - And - A few bug fixes..
notes.notes:
The biggest change to Rock 'N Roll with this update is the following changes made to choosing difficulty 1 before you begin a game:

- The name of Difficulty 1 has changed from "I'm a Wuss" to "Take it Easy on Me!" ..After all, not everyone is a classic action arcade game extraordinaire (including myself) and just because you desire a less brutal game doesn't make you a "wuss"!  I think this name for wanting to play an easier difficulty is a much better, less insulting choice.  

- About 90% or more of the smallest asteroid chunk spawns have been eliminated by choosing difficulty 1 now as only "small" asteroids will ever break into chunks when shot and even that is 50% less likely than on higher difficulty settings.

- Hitting a small asteroid on difficulty 1 acts the same as hitting a small asteroid chunk on difficulties 2-4.  The small asteroids (and chunks) will cause your ship to turn red and go into auto-repair mode for about 15-20 seconds and if you survive, you'll auto-repair back to full health represented by a blue colored ship.

- Because the VDS alien specifically is a very challenging enemy, NO VDS will EVER spawn on difficulty 1.  The floating death skull will now spawn either a Kamikaze worm or a RSA (Random Shooter Alien) if it is touched.

- Spawns of the RSA (Random Shooter Alien) and the Kamikaze worm are now about 70% less likely to occur when you choose difficulty 1.  Unless you touch the floating skull, you should have a lot of time to blast the asteroids without needing to fear the Kamikaze worm blowing you up or the RSA shooting you down.

Nothing else has changed, you'll still need to do well and score the same kind of points and money and everything to prevent getting an "F" score in the final scoring and the scoring and money and pricing of items is being left unaltered on difficulty 1.  It should just be much easier now to survive.

BUG FIXES:

- Fixed an issue with collecting a cannon ball power-up while injured.  Now you should turn yellow as intended if you collect a cannon ball power up while you are injured (red) and you will not finish healing until your cannon ball power up has expired and you return to the red damaged state for the remainder of your repair time required.

- Fixed an issue that would cause the game to continuously loop through the main menu with some specific controllers and/or controller states preventing proper play of the game.

- Fixed an issue that would cause a kamikaze worm to sometimes immediately disappear if it spawned too close to an asteroid.

That's about it, please let me know what you think of the new "easier" and "less brutal" difficulty 1 gameplay.  Is it still too hard?  Did I make it too easy?  Be sure and let me know your thoughts below!

Have fun out there!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.70 - New Improved Look, New Help With M.E.S.A. Ship Protection! ..Much More!
notes.notes:
Okay, a pretty big update tonight with patch 0.70...

ADDED:
-------------------------

M.E.S.A. Ship Protection - MESA Stands for Mass Energy Shield Augmentation and is now available for purchase between every wave of asteroids at the Ship Upgrade screen!  With MESA, you'll get a huge relief on impacts that would otherwise kill one of your lives.  When you purchase MESA, it only lasts a single level (wave of asteroids and enemies) but it might very well be worth the cost as any impact that would normally kill you will now activate the "mass energy shields" and save your life, only causing your ship to turn red for about a 20 second long period of time, after which your ship will automatically repair itself to full health (just as you'd normally see only with the smallest chunks, now you have the same protection even against the largest asteroids and even kamikaze worm suicide bombs and enemy shots from both the Random Shooter Alien and the VDS!)  ..Talk about OP!  Mesa is definitely OP protection that should save a few lives out there, but beware it is expensive, only lasts one level, and you can be killed while your ship is red and in repair as well as if the VDS gets close enough to eat you.  

G.E.O.S. Gems can now be purchased from the Ship Upgrade Screen!  Only one G.E.O.S Gem per visit to the Ship Upgrade screen can be purchased with cash.. if you have enough.  And with all the other tempting things you could spend your game cash on, is a G.E.O.S gem really worth the price?  ..Your loved ones back home might think so!  The choice is yours.. and this is just one more option for you now in Rock 'N Roll!


CHANGED:
-----------------------------

Several screens including the main game screen have been completely changed with new fonts used to replace the old.  I always knew that I would go in later and make the game look better once I got the basic game mechanics in and working pretty good.  This update to the overall look and feel of the game is just a step in that direction!  (Take at look at the comparison image comparing beta version 0.68 on several screens to those same screens now in beta version 0.70)  Hopefully this new improved look will be more appealing to most players!  ...Let me know!

Comparison of some screens with this update: http://imgur.com/8ZwwGze

You can now quickly skip through the end of level statistics screen by simply pressing your A button, the space bar, or the left mouse button.

The end GEOS save the world screen now explodes more quickly than before, cutting about 10 seconds off of the old 25 second long dramatics.

All power-ups now flash and are much more visible than before to make them easier to see in the chaos.

There's a few other minor things I changed for the better as well, but not every little thing is coming to mind after the past 12 hours of coding this last patch today.  ..Hopefully you enjoy the changes!  Be sure and let me know below!  Have fun blasting asteroids, those crazy kamikaze worms, the VDS killers and the Random Shooter Alien!  ..Be safe up there!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.68 - Better Collisions When Smashing Asteroids!
notes.notes:
This patch is a huge overhaul in my code on how collisions occurred between you and asteroids when using a Spi-Roll attack, or the Smasher or Cannon ball power-ups.  Asteroids will now much more properly break apart at or near the initial collision point rather then sometimes randomly spawning breakdown pieces all over the screen.  There's some tweaking still needed I'm sure, but I believe this update makes asteroids break apart way better than previously.  I think you'll see a big difference if you've played any version previous to this 0.68 patch!  Let me know!

Also changed was you now have the ability to skip through the statistics screen with either the Space Bar or the A button on your controller to more quickly get back into the action!

Kamikaze worms have been given a little more shielding against your firepower and will take a few more shots to be killed.  Spi-Roll attacks and smashing them with the Cannon Ball or Smasher power-ups remain unchanged.  

Kamikaze worms will no longer chase you if you wrap around the edge of the screen to escape and lose you, but instead likely turn 180 degrees to continue seeking you out.

The  Random Shooter Alien will no longer kill you if you hit it with a Smasher power up unless your speed is at least 145 as indicated by your "Speed" indicator at the top of the screen.  To ensure a kill a kill with the Smasher power-up, make sure you are hitting it at a minimum of 170 or you could see your demise!  (145 while using a "Smasher" power-up will sometimes kill a Random Shooter Alien, but 170 or higher while using the Smasher power-up is needed to be certain you destroy it)

The VDS will no longer shoot small or medium sized asteroids, but instead focus more on you and the larger asteroids which could crumble into more fragments.  (He still fires random shots to keep him from being too powerful and may hit anything with a random shot, including smaller asteroids or you!)

I hope that you enjoy the new changes, Good luck in your missions to save our planet in your games of Rock 'N Roll!

notes.title: Rock 'N Roll TO Release 24 hours EARLY!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

With the realization that this game isn't going to get much more 'complete" in the next 24 hours, and with all the hours I've spent updating the game in the past two weeks, I've decided to launch a full day earlier than originally announced!

Please keep in mind that this game is still very much in early access and I fully expect bugs, game exploits, and problems to be in my game for the next couple of months as it goes through the early access development period.

Also please understand that this game right now has no controllable game options at this point.  While some options are planned, right now all you can do to control the volume is turn your speakers or headset down and you can turn the main game music song on and off during the game.  

The game currently launches in a default 1600 x 900 resolution, and you can hit the F key to alternate the game between full screen and windowed mode.  If you don't have a computer with a wide screen monitor or a lower resolution, the game should still work just fine for you, as it will automatically lower it's settings to adjust to whatever resolution you are set at on your computer.

The game also currently does not have trading cards, achievements, or high scores.  Those are all things planned at this point but not promised as this is my first published game on Steam and I will need to figure out how to make and configure my game with work with Steam.

However, I can say that I truly believe that what is offered now at the launch in early access is a great value for your money and will only get better as I continue to update and add content to this game!  

With early access, I want to deliver a fantastic gaming value to all of my customers who choose to buy this game and support me.  Once I have decided this game is ready for a final release and comes out of early access, I fully expect the price to be higher as I plan to add a lot of content to the game including local multiplayer game modes.

I look forward to reading and hearing feedback on my first game to be published on Steam, and hope that the early access adopters of my game help me to mold a much better game in the end with suggestions, ideas, and feedback!  

If you choose to support me and my game here in early access, a warm "thank you" goes out to you and I truly hope that you enjoy my game!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.67 - Resources Can Be Moved With Missiles, New Look Blaster Alien, Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
A few changes and random bug fixes in this update...

Added:

Resources now will move in the direction being shot from by your ship.  This can be helpful towards moving a resource out of your way to blast an asteroid sometimes, but at the cost of a harder to acquire resource due to its increased movement speed.

Every resource has it's own unique weight and will not be able to be moved as easily with bullets as others.  Using a little research on the atomic weight of the different resources, I've made their real life weight apply in my game as in gold, platinum, iridium, and osmium weigh much more than resources like iron, nickel, and titanium.  The heavier the weight, the slower you'll be able to nudge it with missile fire and the lower maximum speed it will have inside the game.


Changed:

Beta introduction screen has been changed to better give players and initial early access customers a few tips on how to survive a little longer in the game and to encourage them to post their feedback on the Steam forums here.

The Alien Blaster Enemy has been changed to have a completely new look in time for the early access launch.

The VDS enemy was nerfed in his ability to fire so frequently.  He now has a slightly slower firing rate, but his missiles can still be devastating to both you and the risk of asteroids crumbling.

The Kamikaze Space Worm now moves more freely and will search the screen for you with better coverage and less path predictability. 


Fixed:

I think I resolved an issue that would sometimes cause the kamikaze worm to get stuck spiraling in an endless circle on the edge of the screen.

Fixed an issue that would cause the VDS to rarely re-spawn with 1 hp of health right after killing him.

Fixed an issue that would cause the VDS to sometimes teleport to you if you picked up a G.E.O.S gem and eat you.  He'll now just get mad and growl at you and likely fire a missile at you instead!  Be careful picking up a G.E.O.S gem if there is a VDS on the screen, they do not want you saving the earth!  ;-)

That's about it for this update, I'm sure there is more updates to come in the coming days.  Enjoy the game!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.65 - Introducing GEOS Gems, Save the World!
notes.notes:
This is a pretty big update with 0.65.. You now see the purpose of why you are shooting asteroids out in space, and you have new GEOS gems you can work to collect to help you in your mission to save your loved ones back on Earth.

ADDED:
-------------------------------

- GEOS Gems - G.E.O.S stands for Galactic Emeralds Of Sacrifice.  These are shiny new gems that will drop from a blasted asteroid once you fill the new "GEOS Progression Bar" located in the top right portion of your game screen.  When one drops, you have approximately 45 seconds to collect it or it will shatter all over your screen.  Each GEOS gem collected before you run out of lives will give you one more chance at saving the Earth from the asteroid bombardment from space.

- End Game - After you expire all of your lives (ships) in the game, you'll be taken to an end game screen full of 50 GEOS gem reflections of Earth.  Only one of these 50 reflections of Earth is the real Earth that you need to protect with any GEOS gems you've collected during your game.  Use your GEOS gems to protect the reflections you believe might be the real vision of Earth and watch as the reflections start to blow up in front of you.  Each game will be different, as the correct reflection of Earth is procedurally generated every time you start a new game.  Can you save the Earth with the correct placement of your hard earned GEOS gems?

A few tweaks and minor bugs were fixed in this patch, but mostly it was all the additional content of the GEOS gems and giving the player a mission to save Earth in this update.

I hope you enjoy this new content that will likely be my last actual addition to the game until after the games enters its early access launch just a couple of days from now.  Please post in the comments your thoughts, any bugs or problems you experience, and good luck out there!

This patch is another small patch adding a few new elements to the depth of the game and fixing a few issues...

Added:

When you narrowly escape a near hit in the game, you get 1,000 points for surviving, but using your shield time to collect easy close call points by simply passing over an asteroid has been resolved.

- Fixed a ragged sound issue when using the canon-ball power-up.

- Fixed an issue that could cause a red shooter enemy ship to sometimes spawn right on top of you if it spawned near you during a spi-roll event.

That pretty much covers the additions and fixes made for this patch.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.59 - Skippable Intro, Asteroids Can Break or Crumble if Crashed Into, more...
notes.notes:
This patch is another small patch adding a few new elements to the depth of the game and fixing a few issues...

Added:

- You can now skip the intro by simply pressing the A or Y button on the controller, or by hitting the space bar or the ESC key on the keyboard.

- All asteroids now have a chance of breaking down into smaller asteroids if you crash your ship into one, the smaller the asteroid that you collide into, the better chance if it breaking.  You also score points equal to shooting it if it does break.  However, crashing into an asteroid also greatly increases it's chance of crumbling, again the smaller the size.. the higher the chance of a crumble occurring.

Fixed:

- Fixed an exploit discovered that allowed you to quit the game while in the middle of a spi-roll event and restart the game in an endless spi-roll loop, making you invincible as your spi-roll would just never end.

- Fixed an issue that allowed you to simply pass over asteroids when spawning or re-spawning with your temporary shields and collect an easy 1,000 "close call" points.  When you narrowly escape a near hit in the game, you get 1,000 points for surviving, but using your shield time to collect easy close call points by simply passing over an asteroid has been resolved.

- Fixed a ragged sound issue when using the canon-ball power-up.

- Fixed an issue that could cause a red shooter enemy ship to sometimes spawn right on top of you if it spawned near you during a spi-roll event.

That pretty much covers the additions and fixes made for this patch.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.58 - Game Intro Added, Shot Accuracy Fixed, Kamikaze Worm Nerfed
notes.notes:
Another small update with nothing huge added, but a few small changes and bugs have been fixed.

Simple game introduction added that will get a little fancier over the coming days, but works for now as a base intro to the game.

The main fix in this update is the way your shot accuracy was calculated, a formula I originally put into the game when I first worked on this game back in February.  Thanks to Steam user rustyfoxes for reporting a strange looking occurrence when the game reported they got a shot accuracy of 116% for the level.  I made a post in the bug reporting thread on the man forums and uploaded this screenshot which explains what was happening and how I fixed it: http://imgur.com/fx0MBJg.

Also added was additional bonus points based on what level you complete if you score a minimum of a 25% shot accuracy (the higher your shot accuracy and the higher the level and the higher difficulty you chose at the start, the higher your bonus will be)

Kamikaze worms were also nerfed in their ability to sometimes blow themselves up from too far of a distance from your ship to kill you.  They now have to get closer to you before being able to self detonate and kill you, giving you more time to react in clutch situations.

Also worth noting, this is the now the 25th update I've made this game since originally uploading it to Steam the first time just over a week ago.  Slowly but surely I think I am making this game a better overall experience for anyone who will play it.  Still a lot of work to do I'm sure, and a ton of things I want to add yet, but I plan on adding a lot of content in the early access phase of this game which I expect to last between three and six months.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.57 - New Power-Up Time Running Out Warning, A Bug Fix & Balance Tweak
notes.notes:
Another small, but critical update adds a warning to all power ups and fixes a crucial problem with the K-OS power-up...  

I added a simple 3 chime warning to warn you when there is just five seconds left before your power-up expires, something that might definitely help save a life especially when using a power-up like "smasher" or "canon ball".

A pretty crucial bug was also rectified that would cause the K-OS power up to continue on forever if you picked it right before ending a level with the K-OS still in effect.  This was a huge bug fix because the speed boost and inability to slow down would stay once you entered the next level but the power-up timer would never end!  And if you've ever played the game and seen how K-OS works, having it last forever would mean almost certain death of all your remaining ships since power-ups continue to new ship spawns with any remaining power up time.

Also a tweak was done to lower the amount of rotation speed you get when upgrading your rotating speed, a small tweak, but definitely worth noting.

I expect my game to get a ton of these small balance fixes and tweaks over the coming days.  ..This is actually the 23rd update I've put through on this game since uploading my first build to Steam.  

...Time to Rock 'N Roll!  :-)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.56 - Too Much Crumbling From The Non-VDS Enemy Has Been Fixed!
notes.notes:
Critical bug making the little red shooter enemy you see even at the lowest levels super over-powered has been fixed.  This little bug in my code was causing even the normal enemy to shatter rocks into crumbles just like the new VDS enemy, and this had to be patched immediately.

Other changes made include increasing the hit box of both the small crumble chunks and the VDS red crumble chunks bigger so they are easier to shoot and require not such precise shots (think a minor touch of "auto-aim" assistance on shooting the smallest asteroids you'll see).  Hopefully this will make the game a little less unforgiving when it comes to trying to hit those little buggers.

An increase to the starting rotating speed of your ship just a hair with this patch was made and starting on the "I'm a wuss" level of difficulty was also made just a tad easier to hopefully help better balance the game.

More changes and balance fixes coming in the final days before my early access launch, and maybe a surprise or two.. but mostly it's just going to be smoothing out wrinkles and hopefully making this game a pleasant game experience for everyone who buys it come launch day this Friday, July 14th!  

Happy gaming!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.55 - The Evil and Chaotic VDS Killer is Live!
notes.notes:
By far the toughest killer yet (and toughest challenge to code) is live now in this 0.55 beta patch!  

The VDS (Vaporous Death Spewer) will make an already challenging game much more intense as he not only tries to blast you, but he will take aim for the biggest asteroids on your screen in an attempt to crumble them into tons of hurling little chunks!  To add insult to injury this killer will laugh a true sinister laugh if his crumbling of large asteroids is successful, because this will put your life in dire danger!

Killing the VDS will take hundreds of shots or a multitude of successive attacks using the special tools and power-ups provided to you!  Part of the fun will be learning the best way to attack this new killer, but you'll need your wits and quick reflexes and perhaps a little luck to send the VPS back to the hell he came from!

I'm sure there will be new bugs with all the new mechanics introduced to the game with this latest killer add, so if you play my game, please post your comments, bugs, and or suggestions in this forums!  I look forward to hearing from you!

To everyone who has yet to buy the game, rest assured that I will continue to  pour in lots of time and effort to making sure I deliver a solid gaming value for the small price I'm introducing this game with its early access launch on Friday, July 14th!

Thank you for reading, and for your interest in Rock 'N Roll!   ..More to come!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.52 - Keyboard & Mouse Fix + Other tweaks and minor bugs resolved.
notes.notes:
After pumping out Update beta update 0.50 yesterday morning and taking the rest of holiday 4th of July off, I came back this morning to test my game with the keyboard and mouse rather than my gamepad as I had been using since putting in controller support.  I was frustrated to see that changes I had made to make the controller support work had bypassed any users using the keyboard and mouse to be able to use their earned cash to buy upgrades.  When I sold my resources using the mouse and keyboard, it would just skip right to the next level and completely skip the ability to buy upgrades!  Argh!

That silly little mistake has been fixed now, and both controller and keyboard & mouse users should at least be able to play the game, though I am sure there are still bugs and glitches to find and vanquish.  

- This is exactly why I am releasing my first published game here on Steam in early access.  I know that once more people start buying and playing this game, people are bound to find little problems that need squashed, but my hope is that I will have all the big problems ironed out before anyone buys it.

Other changes made worth noting in this patch..

- Had the game skip over any resources that you didn't collect, as it didn't seem efficient or useful to show players values of resources which they simply didn't have any at the selling screen.  Now the game only shows you the resources you did collect and gives you the option to sell those for points or cash.

- Pictures, diagrams, and better explanation on selling and upgrade screens to better help players understand what they need to push on both a controller and the keyboard to sell resources and buy upgrade items.

- Fixed a random bug that would cause your ship to explode if the enemy shooter ship would hit the kamikaze worm at the precise time you hit the enemy ship.  This is something that probably would only happen one game in fifty, but it has been fixed now.

Other minor tweaks and optimizations, reducing some needless code, making the game about 78 kb smaller in size.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.50 - Full Resource Selling + Ship Upgrades Is Live!
notes.notes:
I've been hard at work the past few days getting a full system into Rock 'N Roll which allows you to sell every type of resource you collected in the previous level for your choice of either bonus score points OR for cash.  Extra points is always tempting not only to increase your score, but also because that's the easiest way to get extra lives.  Cash is tempting with some nice upgrades and purchasable items to help you take on the ever increasingly challenging levels ahead of you.

Here's a look at what's been added to and changed with Rock 'N Roll Beta version .50:

ADDED:
------------------------
Resources can now be sold if you complete a level, and you'll get to choose whether to sell each type of resource (iron, titanium, platinum etc) for either score points or for cash.

Cash earned can be saved up or used between levels on the Ship Upgrade screen to purchase:
     - Increased Rotation Speed (7 upgrades available, each costing more money than the last) 
     - Increased Firing Power (9 upgrades available, each costing more money than the last)
     - Extra "Spi-Roll" attacks (prices on these fluctuate every time you enter the Ship Upgrade screen)
     - Increased Power-Up Time (each power-up time increase costs more money than the last)

Extra Ships can drop just like a power up at random during game play. (approx a 4% chance out of the 9 possible power-ups which could spawn)  You'll need to maneuver your ship and collect it before it disappears to earn the extra life.  Note that extra ships are also earned by scoring over 20,000 points, 50,000 points, and every 50,000 points thereafter.  Extra ships cannot be purchased with cash.

CHANGES:
------------------------
Controller controls have been made to be slightly less sensitive.  Also previously in version 0.42, using the controller to thrust was done by moving your left thumb stick upwards.  Due to some beta testers finding this frustrating with the same thumb stick also controlling clockwise and counter-clockwise rotation of your ship, the thrust control has now been changed to the Right Throttle button on the controller (R2).  (Keyboard controls remain unchanged from before)

Many screens and fonts have been changed to give the game a better overall look.

Several small game balances and minor changes have also been made in this patch.

* Much more to come to Rock 'N Roll in the coming days before it officially launches on Friday, July 14th!  Some changes coming include a deadly new enemy called the V.D.S., high scores tracking, and options to better adjust your volumes and resolution as well as controller sensitivity and more!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.42 - Controller Support has been added.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.  Since uploading this game to Steam just a few days ago, my upcoming Rock 'N Roll game has already seen a total of 14 updates, mostly minor tweaks and fixes, but today brought version 0.42 which added  controller support to this game.

Lots more work is planned for this game before it officially launches on July 14th in early access.  

Here or some of the priority features that are planned for this game before it launches and during the early access period:

- Currently, resources can be collected that drop from the asteroids which you blast.  These resources are automatically sold for general market values with a small randomization for bonus score points if you complete the level (clear all rocks on a screen).  Soon, you'll have an option for every resourse you collect to sell if for either X score points or Y game cash and game cash can be saved and used to purchase many different ship upgrades over the course of a game.

- Ship upgrades will be introduced which can be purchased with game cash you can choose to sell any collected resources for at the end of each level.  These upgrades will only improve your ships attributes during that game however.

- High scores will be introduced to the game, first just local high scores kept at your computer the game is installed on, but global high scores and the ability to compete against your Steam friends highest score is planned!  (Steam global high scores may not be in the game until after launch at some point in the early access developement period)

- A mission mode is planned to be added to this game to make you feel more of a purpose and story behind all the action in this game.

- A local two player mode is definitely planned and will offer several options such as co-op or versus, and level of asteroids etc.

- Bosses are planned for this game, huge space enemies with tons of health to add even more variety and challenge to this game for those desiring even more challenge than this game currently offers.  (This is something planned further down the early access development line)

These are just a few of the changes I am currently planning for Rock 'N Roll.  Early access will also give me the opportunity to take the players suggestions and ideas to help better define how this game ultimately turns out!  While every planned feature may not make it into the final version, I do definitely plan on working hard on this game to make sure it offers a great value to my customers who decide to give this game a try!

Please feel free to use the forums I have to give me your thoughts, suggestions, and to ask questions!  Thank you for your time, and have a great day!
